a: Lechattechilla katane. velema leh: gezera dilma kedem vachaletz lerishona beresha! "velo mityaybmot" katane, delekka din yibbum hacha kelal.
Velema leh: gezera shemma yamut, veasur levattel mitzvat yevamin! rabbi yochanan lemita la chayesh.
Velema leh: rabbi elazar hi, deamar: kevan sheamda alav shaa achat beissur — neesra alav olamit. middesefa rabbi elazar, resha lav rabbi elazar.
Venema lehu: dinful bevat achat, verabbi yose haggelili hi, deamar: efshar letzamtzem! la setam lan tanna kerabbi yose haggelili.
Velema leh: dela yadinan he neful beresha.
I hachi — hayeynu dekatane kadmu vechansu yotziu? bishlama rishona, amrinan leh: man shera lach? ella sheniyya, amar: chavray sheniyya yaybem, ana rishona meyaybem.
Hayeynu dekaamar leh: achayot eni yodea mi shenaan.
Tenan: hayta achat mehen asura al haechad issur erva — asur bah umuttar baachotah, vehashsheni asur bishtehen. salka datach dinfala chamoto techilla.
Veammay? leku chatan leyaybem hach deenah chamoto beresha, veteheve chamoto legabbe iddach kivama shehuttera veneesra vechazra vehuttera, tachzor lehetterah harishon!
Amar rav pappa: kegon dinfala hach deenah chamoto beresha.

Rabbi eliezer omer: bet shammay omrim vechulei. tanya, rabbi eliezer omer, bet shammay omrim: yekayyeymu, uvet hillel omrim: yotziu. rabbi shimon omer: yekayyeymu. abba shaul omer: kal haya lahem levet hillel bedavar ze, shebbet shammay omrim: yotziu, uvet hillel omrim: yekayyeymu.
Rabbi shimon keman? i kevet shammay — hayeynu rabbi eliezer. i kevet hillel — hayeynu abba shaul! hachi kaamar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel bedavar ze.
Hayta achat mehem kulei. ha tenena chada zimna: achotah keshehi yevimtah — o choletzet o mityaybemet!
Tzericha, dei ashmevinan hatam: mishshum delekka lemigzar mishshum sheni, aval hacha, deikka lemigzar mishshum sheni — ema la.
Vei ashmuinan hacha: mishshum deikka sheni deka mochach, aval hatam, delekka sheni — ema la. tzericha.
Issur mitzva kulei. ha name tenena:
b: Issur mitzva veissur kedushsha — choletzet velo mityaybemet! hatam, issur mitzva lechoda, hacha, issur mitzva, vaachotah.
Salka datach amena: lekum issur mitzva bimkom issur erva — vetityaybem, ka mashma lan.
Vetityaybem? kevan demiddeorayyta ramya kammeh, ka faga baachot zekukato. salka datach amena: mishshum mitzva avud rabbanan, ka mashma lan.
Hayta achat mehen kulei. ha tu lema li, hayeynu hach: ma li lechad ma li litre?!
Tzericha: dei ashmevinan hatam, mishshum deikka sheni demochach, aval hacha, delekka sheni deka mochach, ema la.
Vei ashmevinan hacha: adderabba, tarvavyyhu mochchi ahadade, aval iddach — la, tzericha.
Zo hi sheamru vechulei. "zo hi" lemaote may? lemaote issur mitzva laze veissur mitzva laze.
Ha tu lema li, hayeynu hach: ma li lechad, ma li litre?!

Mahu detema: ki la amrinan oke issur mitzva bimkom issur erva — hecha deikka lemigzar mishshum sheni, aval hecha delekka lemigzar mishshum sheni, ema: lehay okemna issur mitzva bimkom issur erva, ulehay [okemna] issur mitzva bimkom issur erva, veliyyaybmu, ka mashma lan.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav, vechen tane rabbi chiyyay: bechullan ani kore bahen, haasura laze mutteret laze, vaachotah keshehi yevimtah — o choletzet o mityaybemet.
Verav yehuda metargem mechamoto veelach, aval shitta bave deresha — la.
May tama — kevan devitto beunesin hu demashkachat la, benissuin la mashkachat la.
Benissuin kamayyre, beunesin la ka mayyre.

Veabbaye metargem af bitto (baa) meanusato, kevan deashkoche mashkachat la, i baaya — beunesin tehve, i baaya — benissuin tihve. aval eshet achiv shello haya beolamo — la. kevan deallibba derabbi shimon hu demashkachat la, allibba derabbanan la mashkachat la — biflugeta la kamayyre.
Verav safra metargem af eshet achiv shello haya beolamo, umashkachat la beshitta ache veallibba derabbi shimon. vesimanaych: met nolad veyibbem, met nolad veyibbem.

Reuven veshimon nesuin shete achayot, levi vihuda nesuin shete nochriyyot. met reuven, nolad yissashchar, veyibbem levi. met shimon, nolad zevulun, veyibbem yehuda. metu levi vihuda belo banim, venaflu lehu kamme yissashchar uzevulun.
Haasura laze — mutteret laze. vehaasura laze — mutteret laze. vaachotah shehi yevimtah.
Lema li yibbem yehuda? bela yibbem yehuda name mashkachat la!
Mishshum tzara. ha tinach tzara, tzara detzara may ikka lememar?
Kegon dahadar veyabbeminhu name gad veasher.
Mishna shelosha achin, shenayim mehen nesuin shete achayot, o ishsha uvittah, o ishsha uvat bittah, o ishsha uvat benah — hare ellu choltzot velo mityaybmot. verabbi shimon poter.
Hayta achat mehen asura alav issur erva — asur bah, umuttar baachotah. issur mitzva o issur kedushsha — choltzot velo mityaybmot.

Gemara tanya: rabbi shimon poter bishtehen min hachalitza umin hayyibbum, shenneemar: "veishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror". beshaa shennaasu tzarot zo lazo — lo yehe lecha likkuchin afillu beachat mehen.
Hayta achat mehen kulei. ha tu lema li, hayeynu hach!
Lerabbi shimon itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil veamar rabbi shimon shete achayot lo choltzot velo mityaybmot, ligzor mishshum shete achayot dealma, kamashma lan.
Issur mitzva kulei.

a: Veha amar rabbi shimon: shete achayot lo choltzot velo mityaybmot!
Gezera mishshum issur mitzva dealma.
Ha tinach ihi, achotah may ikka lememar? gezera achotah mishshum latta dida.
Veha gabbe erva la gazrinan? shane erva demigmar gemiri la inashe, vekala it la.
Mishna shelosha achin, shenayim nesuim shete achayot veechad mufene. met echad mibbaale achayot, veasa bah mufene maamar. veachar kach met achiv hashsheni —

Bet shammay omrim: ishto immo, vehallezu tetze mishshum achot ishsha. uvet hillel omrim: motzi et ishto beget uvachalitza, veeshet achiv bachalitza. zo hi sheamru: oy lo al ishto, veoy lo al eshet achiv.
Gemara "zo hi" lemaote may? lemaote hach derabbi yehoshua, dela avdinan kevoteh. ella i kerabban gamliel, i kerabbi elazar.
Amar rabbi elazar: la tema maamar levet shammay kone kinyan gamur, dei bae leappoke saggi la begitta, ella maamar levet shammay eno kone ella lidchot batztzara bilvad.
Amar rabbi avin: af anan name tenena, bet shammay omrim: yekayyeymu. yekayyeymu in — lechattechilla la.
b: Vei salka datach maamar levet shammay kone kinyan gamur: ze yaase maamar veyikne, veze yaase maamar veyikne.
Ella may? doche dechiyyay gemura — ze yaase maamar veyidche, veze yaase maamar veyidche.
Ella may it lach lememar: maamar dehettera — dache, deissura — la dache, hachi name maamar, afillu leman deamar maamar kone kinyan gamur: maamar dehettera kane, deissura la kane.
Rav ashe matne hachi, amar rabbi elazar: la tema maamar levet shammay dache dechiyyay gemura, vetzaratah chalitza name la baaya, ella doche umeshayyer hu.

Amar rabbi avin, af anan name tenena: bet shammay omrim yekayyeymu. yekayyeymu — in, lechattechilla — la. vei salka datach maamar levet shammay doche dechiyyay gemura, ze yaase maamar veyidche, veze yaase maamar veyidche! veella ha katane bet shammay omrim: ishto immo, vehallezu tetze mishshum achot ishsha.
Ella: yevama dechazya lechullehu — chazya lemiktzato, yevama dela chazya lechullehu — la chazya lemiktzato.
Bae rabba: maamar levet shammay, nissuin ose, o erusin ose? amar leh abbaye: lemay hilcheta?

Illema leyorshah velitamme lah ulehafer nedareha, hasheta arusa bealma tane rabbi chiyyay: ishto arusa lo onen velo mittamme la, vechen hi lo onenet velo mittammet lo, meta — eno yorshah, met hu — gova ketubbatah, avad ba maamar mibbaya?
Veella leinyan mesira lechuppa, may? nissuin ose — vela baaya mesira lechuppa, o dilma erusin ose — uvaaya mesira lechuppa?
Amar leh: hasheta la avad ba maamar, ketiv: "yevamah yavo aleha" — beal korchah, avad ba maamar mibbaya?
Amar leh, sheani omer: kol haose maamar bivimto parcha mimmennu zikkat yevamin, vechala alav zikkat erusin. may?
Ta shema: shomeret yavam, ben yavam echad ben shene yevamin — rabbi eliezer omer: yafer. rabbi yehoshua omer: leechad velo lishnayim. rabbi akiva omer: lo leechad velo lishnayim.

Vehavenan ba: bishlama, rabbi akiva savar: en zikka afillu lechad. lerabbi yehoshua: lechad yesh zikka, litre en zikka. ella lerabbi eliezer, nehi name dekasavar yesh zikka, bishlama lechad mefer, ella litre ammay?
Veamar rabbi amme (bar ahava): hacha bemay askinan — kegon daavad ba maamar, uvet shammay hi, deamar: maamar kone kinyan gamur.

I amrat bishlama nissuin ose — mishshum hachi mefer. ella i amrat erusin ose — hechi matze mefer, vehatnan: naara hameorasa — aviha uvalah mefirim nedareha! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: may mefer — mefer beshuttafut.

Ulerabbi elazar, deamar: maamar levet shammay eno kone ella lidchot latztzara bilvad, ammay mefer beshuttafut? amar lach rabbi elazar: emar daamari ana eno kone ella lidchot latztzara bilvad, dela saggi la begitta ella bae name chalitza, lehafer nedareha mi amrinan?
Veibbaet ema, amar lach rabbi elazar: ulerav nachman bar yitzchak mi nicha? mi katane "yaferu"? "yafer" katane. ella, hacha bemay askinan — sheamda baddin, ufasku lah mezonot mishshello,
Vechidrav pinchas mishshemeh derava, deamar rav pinchas mishshemeh derava: kol hannoderet — al daat balah hi noderet.

a: Mishna shelosha achin, shenayim mehem nesuim shete achayot, veechad nasuy nochrit. met echad mibbaale achayot, vechanas nesuy nochrit et ishto umet — harishona yotza mishshum achot ishsha, usheniyya mishshum tzaratah. asa bah maamar umet — nochrit choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Gemara tama daavad ba maamar, ha la avad ba maamar — nochrit yabbome name meyaybma. amar rav nachman: zot omeret en zika, vaafillu bechad acha.

Mishna shelosha achim, shenayim mehem nesuim shete achayot, veechad nasuy nochrit. met hannasuy nochrit, vechanas echad mibbaale achayot et ishto umet — harishona yotzet mishshum achot ishsha, usheniyya — mishshum tzaratah. asa bah maamar umet — nochrit choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Gemara ha tu lema li? hayeynu hach! hasheta: uma hatam daachot ishsha havya tzara lenochrit — amrat nochrit asura, hacha denochrit havya tzara laachot ishsha — lo kol shekken!
Tanna, hach tena beresha vehach chazya lehettera vesharya, vahadar chazya leissura.
Veayyeyde dechabbiva leh akdema, umishna lo zaza mimmekomah.

Mishna shelosha achin, shenayim mehem nesuim shete achayot, veechad nasuy nochrit. met echad mibbaale achayot, vechanas nesuy nochrit et ishto, umeta ishto shel sheni, veachar kach met nesuy nochrit — hare zo asura alav olamit, hoil veneesra alav shaa achat.

Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol yevama sheen ani kore bah bishat nefila "yevamah yavo aleha" — hare hi keeshet ach sheyyesh lah banim, vaasura. may ka mashma lan? tenena: hare zo asura alav olamit, hoil veneesra alav shaa achat!
Mahu detema: hane mille hecha dela ichazya la binfila rishona, aval hecha deichazya la binfila rishona — ema tishtere, ka mashma lan.
Ha name tenena: shene achin nesuin shete achayot, met echad mehem, veachar kach meta ishto shel sheni — hare zo asura alav olamit, hoil veneesra alav shaa achat!
Mahu detema: hatam hu deiddechay la mehay beta ligmare, aval hacha dela iddechay la mehay beta ligmare, ema: miggo dechazya lehay nesuy nochrit, chazya name lehay — ka mashma lan.

Mishna shelosha achim, shenayim mehem nesuin shete achayot, veechad nasuy nochrit. gerash echad mibbaale achayot et ishto, umet nesuy nochrit, uchenasah hamegaresh vamet — zo hi sheamru: vechullan shemmetu o nitgarshu — tzarotehen muttarot.
Gemara tama degerash veachar kach met, aval met veachar kach gerash — asura. amar rav ashe: zot omeret: yesh zika, afillu bitre ache.

Ulerav ashe kashya derav nachman! amar lach rav ashe: hu haddin deaf al gav dela avad ba maamar — nochrit michlatz chaltza, yabbome la miyyaybma. veha dekatane maamar — leappoke bet shammay, deamri: maamar kone
b: Kinyan gamur, ka mashma lan dela kevet shammay.
Ulerav nachman — kashya derav ashe! vechi tema: hu haddin daafillu met veachar kach gerash — tzaratah mutteret, ella "zo hi" lemaote may? lemaote kanas veachar kach gerash.
Hanicha i savar la kerabbi yirmeya, deamar: tavra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo.
Vehay tanna savar mita mappelet, vehay tanna savar nissuin harishonim mappilim.
"Zo hi" lemaote kanas ulevassof gerash. ella i savar la kerava, deamar: leolam chad tanna hu, vezo veen tzarich lomar zo" katane, "zo hi" lemaote may? al korchach kerabbi yirmeya sevira leh.
Ulerava, hanicha i savar la kerav ashe — "zo hi" lemaote met belo geresh. ella i savar la kerav nachman, "zo hi" lemaote may? al korchach kerav ashe sevira leh.

Mishna vechullan shehayu bahen kiddushin o gerushin besafek — hare ellu hatztzarot choltzot velo mityaybmot. ketzad sefek kiddushin? zarak lah kiddushin, safek karov lo safek karov lah — zehu sefek kiddushin.
Sefek gerushin — katav bichtav yado veen alav edim, yesh alav edim veen bo zeman, yesh bo zeman veen bo ella ed echad, zehu sefek gerushin.
Gemara veillu begerushin, safek karov lo safek karov lah la katane.
May tama? amar rabba: ishsha zo bechezkat hetter lashshuk omedet, umissafek atta ba leosrah — al taasrenna missafek.
Amar leh abbaye: i hachi, bekiddushin name nema: ishsha zo bechezkat hetter layyavam omedet, umissafek atta ba leosrah — al taasrenna missafek!
Hatam, lechumera.
Hay — chumera deate lide kulla hu. zimnin deazel hu, umekaddesh la laachota kiddushe vadday.
Vei name, zimnin deate acher umekaddesh la ledida kiddushe vadday, vechevan deasar la mar letzara leyaybome, amri: dekamma — kiddushin, udevatra — lav kiddushin!

a: Kevan deka matzrechat chalitza — midda yadi dechumera bealma hu. i hachi, gerushin name litne, velaytzrecha chalitza, umidda yadi dechumera bealma hu!
Im atta omer choletzet, mityaybemet. hacha name, im atta omer choletzet, mityaybemet! vetityaybem, veen bechach kelum — achazaka ka kayyma.
Etiveh abbaye: nafal habbayit alav veal bat achiv, veen yadua eze mehem met rishon, tzaratah choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Ammay? hacha name, nema: ishsha zo bechezkat hetter lashshuk omedet, umissafek atta ba leosrah — al taasrenna missafek!
Vechi tema: hacha name lechumera — chumera deate lide kulla hu: sheim atta omer choletzet, mityaybemet! gerushin dishchichi — gezaru behu rabbanan, mappolot dela shechichi — la gezaru behu rabbanan.

I name: gerushin dekayyma erva deka mochcha[1], vetzaratah kamatzrechat la chalitza, amri: kamu beh rabbanan begitta degitta mealleya hu, veatu leyaybome letzara. mappolet, mi kamu behu rabbanan bemappolet?
Vegabbe gerushin mi la tenan? vehatnan: hayta omedet birshut harabbim uzerako lah, karov lah — megoreshet, karov lo — enah megoreshet. mechetza al mechetza — megoreshet veenah megoreshet.
Veamrinan: lemay hilcheta? dei kohen hu — asivra leh, vei erva hi — tzaratah baaya chalitza. vela amrinan: sheim atta omer choletzet, mityaybemet!

Ha ittemar ala, rabba verav yosef deamri tarvavyyhu: hacha bishte kitte edim askinan, achat omeret: karov lah, veachat omeret: karov lo, dehave leh sefeka deorayyta. umatnitin dehacha bechat achat, dehave leh sefeka derabbanan.

Umimmay dematnitin dehacha bechat achat? dumeya dekiddushin: ma kiddushin bechat achat, af gerushin bechat achat. vekiddushin gufayyhu, mimmay divchat achat? dilma bishte kitte edim? i bishte kitte edim — tityaybem, veen bechach kelum.
Kayymi edim vekaamri karov lah, veat amrat tityaybem veen bechach kelum?! vetu — bishte kitte edim name, sefeka derabbanan hi, deamrinan: oke tere levahade tere, veishsha okma achazaka!
Midde dehave annichse devar shatya. devar shatya zabben nichse. ato be tere veamri: keshehu chalim zabben, veatu be tere vaamaru: keshehu shote zabben. veamar rav ashe: oke tere lahade tere,
b: Veara okma bechezkat bar shatya!
Ella amar abbaye: "yaggid alav reo". tena bekiddushin, vehu haddin legerushin. tena begerushin, vehu haddin lekiddushin.
Amar leh rava: i "yaggid alav reo", may "zehu" dekatane?

Ella amar rava: kol sheyyesh bekiddushin yesh begerushin, veyesh begerushin ma sheen bekiddushin, vezehu" degerushin lav davka. ella, mishshum ditna "zehu" bekiddushin, tena name "zehu" begerushin. vezehu" dekiddushin lemaote may? lemaote zeman, delekka bekiddushin.
Umippene ma lo tikkenu zeman bekiddushin? hanicha leman deamar mishshum pere — arusa let la pere.
Ella, leman deamar mishshum bat achoto — litakken zeman!
Mishshum deikka dimkaddesh bechaspa veikka dimkaddesh bishtara, la takkun rabbanan zeman.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe: veha avda, deikka dekane bechaspa veikka bishtara, vetakkun rabbanan zeman! hatam rubba bishtara, hacha rubba bechaspa.
Ibbaet ema, mishshum dela efshar. hechi lebed? laynneche gabbe dida — machaka leh. laynneche gabbe dideh — zimnin devat achoto hi umechappe ala.
Laynneche gabbe edim — i dizchiyiri layto layshud. vei la — zimnin dechazu mikketava veatu mashadi, verachamana amar: "mippihem", velo mippi chetavam.
I hachi, begerushin name nema hachi! hatam — lehatztzala dida kaate, hacha — lechova dida kaate.
Mishna shelosha achin nesuin shalosh nochriyyot, umet echad mehen, veasa bah hashsheni maamar, umet — hare ellu choltzot velo mityaybmot.
Shenneemar: "umet echad mehen... yevamah yavo aleha" — shealeha zikat yavam echad, velo shealeha zikat shene yevamin. rabbi shimon omer: meyaybem leezo sheyyirtze, vecholetz lashsheniyya.
Gemara vei zikat shene yevamin deorayyta, chalitza name la tive! ella midderabbanan, ugezera shemma yomru shete yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad mityaybmot.
Uneyaybem lachada venichlotz lachada! gezera shemma yomru: bayit echad, miktzato banuy

a: Umiktzato chalutz.
Veyomru! i dimyaybem vahadar chaletz — hachi name.
Ella gezera dilma chaletz beresha vahadar meyaybem, vekam leh baasher lo yivne", verachamana amar: kevan shello bana — shuv lo yivne.
Amar rava: natan get lemaamaro — huttera tzaratah. aval hi asura, demichallefa bevaalat get.
Ikka deamri, amar rava: natan get lemaamaro — huttera afillu hi. may tama? may daavad ba — shakleh.
Mishna shene achin nesuin shete achayot, umet echad mehen, veachar kach meta ishto shel sheni — hare zo asura alav olamit, hoil veneesra alav shaa achat.

Gemara peshita! hasheta, uma hatam dela middachya mehay beta ligmare — amrat la, hacha deka middachya mehay beta ligmare — la kol shekken! tanna — ha tena beresha, vehach chazya lehettera vesharya, vahadar chazya leissura. veayyeyde dechabbiva leh akdema, umishna lo zaza mimmekomah.

Tanu rabbanan: ba aleha — chayyayv aleha mishshum eshet ach, umishshum achot ishsha, divre rabbi yose. rabbi shimon omer: eno chayyayv ella mishshum eshet ach bilvad. veha tanya, rabbi shimon omer: eno chayyayv ella mishshum achot ishsha bilvad!
La kashya: kan shennasa chay, veachar kach nasa met. kan shennasa met, veachar kach nasa chay.
Verabbi shimon, hecha denasa met veachar kach nasa chay, kevan deissur achot ishsha la chayel — tityaybem yabbome!
Amar rav ashe: issur achot ishsha mitla tele vekae, i paka issur eshet ach — ate issur achot ishsha vechayel, vehilkach la paka.
Vesavar rabbi yose issur chal al issur? veha tanya: avar avera sheyyesh bah shete mitot — niddon bachamura. rabbi yose omer: niddon bazzikka harishona habbaa alav.
Vetanya: ketzad amar rabbi yose niddon bazzikka harishona habbaa alav? chamoto venaaset eshet ish — niddon bachamoto. eshet ish venaaset chamoto — niddon beeshet ish.
b: Amar rabbi avahu: mode rabbi yose beissur mosif.
Tinach hecha denasa chay veachar kach nasa met — miggo deittosaf issur legabbe achim, ittosaf issur legabbe dideh.
Ella hecha denasa met veachar kach nasa chay, may issur mosif ikka?
Vechi tema miggo deittesar bechullehu achvota — hay issur kolel hu.

Ella amar rava: maale ani alav keillu asa shetayim, veeno chayyayv ella achat. vechen ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: maale ani alav keillu asa shetayim, veeno chayyayv ella achat. may nafka minna? lekovro ben reshaim gemurim.

Uviflugeta. deittemar: zar sheshshimmesh beshabbat, rabbi chiyyay omer: chayyayv shetayim. bar kappara omer: en chayyayv ella achat. kafatz rabbi chiyyay venishba: haavoda! kach shamati merabbi: shetayim. kafatz bar kappara venishba: haavoda! kach shamati merabbi: achat.

Hitchil rabbi chiyyay ladun: shabbat lakkol neesra, keshehuttera bammikdash — etzel kohanim huttera. lechohanim huttera, velo lezarim. yesh kan mishshum zarut, veyesh kan mishshum shabbat. hitchil bar kappara ladun: shabbat lakkol neesra, keshehuttera bammikdash — huttera. en kan ella zarut.

Baal mum sheshshimmesh betumea. rabbi chiyyay omer: chayyayv shetayim. bar kappara omer: en chayyayv ella achat. kafatz rabbi chiyyay venishba: haavoda! kach shamati merabbi: shetayim. kafatz bar kappara venishba: haavoda! kach shamati merabbi: achat.

Hitchil rabbi chiyyay ladun: tumea lakkol neesra, keshehuttera bammikdash — etzel kohanim temimim huttera. lechohanim temimim huttera, velo levaale mumin. yesh kan mishshum baale mumin, veyesh kan mishshum tumea. hitchil bar kappara ladun: tumea lakkol neesra, keshehuttera bammikdash — huttera, en kan ella mishshum baal mum.

Zar sheachal melika, rabbi chiyyay omer: chayyayv shetayim. bar kappara omer: en chayyayv ella achat. kafatz rabbi chiyyay venishba: haavoda! kach shamati merabbi: shetayim. kafatz bar kappara venishba: haavoda! kach shamati merabbi: achat.

Hitchil rabbi chiyyay ladun: nevela lakkol neesra. keshehuttera bammikdash — etzel kohanim huttera. lechohanim huttera, velo lezarim. yesh kan mishshum zarut, veyesh kan mishshum melika. hitchil bar kappara ladun: nevela lakkol neesra, keshehuttera bammikdash — huttera, en kan ella mishshum zarut.

a: Bemay kamippalgi — beissur kolel, veallibba derabbi yose. rabbi chiyyay savar: rabbi yose beissur kolel michayyayv tarte, bar kappara savar: la michayyayv ella chada.
Umay issur kolel ikka hacha? bishlama zar: meikkara shere bimlacha veasur baavoda. atya la shabbat, miggo deka mittesar bimlacha — mittesar name baavoda.
Baal mum: meikkara shere baachila, veasur baavoda. ittammi leh, miggo deka mittesar baachila — mittesar name baavoda. ella melika — bevat achat hi demashkachat la, beissur kolel la mashkachat la.
Ella, kamippalgi beissur bevat achat, veallibba derabbi yose. rabbi chiyyay savar: rabbi yose beissur bat achat michayyayv tarte, uvar kappara savar: la michayyayv ella chada.
Vehacha, may issur bat achat ikka hacha? zar sheshshimmesh beshabbat — kegon deayyti shete searot beshabbat, dehavya lehu zarut veshabbat bahade hadade.
Baal mum name — kegon deayyti shete searot veittammi leh, dehavya leh baal mum vetumea bahade hadade. i name, shechatach etzbao besakkin temea.
Bishlama lerabbi chiyyay, ki atneyeh ledideh — allibba derabbi yose, ki atneyeh levar kappara — allibba derabbi shimon. ella levar kappara, rabbi chiyyay shakkore ka meshakker?
Ella: kamippalgi beissur bat achat, veallibba derabbi shimon: bishlama lerabbi chiyyay, ka mishteva leappoke lerabbi shimon mechezkeh. ella levar kappara — lema leh leishtevoe? kashya.
Bishlama levar kappara, ki atneyeh rabbi ledideh — allibba derabbi shimon, ki atneyeh lerabbi chiyyay — allibba derabbi yose. ella lerabbi chiyyay bar kappara, shakkore ka meshakker?
Amar lach rabbi chiyyay: ki atneyeh rabbi ledideh, tarte liftur atneyeh,
b: Veissur kolel atneyeh, veallibba derabbi shimon. vechazya (l)bar kappara lezar sheachal melika, veayyeyde dedamya la — arva bahadayyhu, veayyen ba, vela ashkach ella bevat achat.
Vesavar: middeha bevat achat, ha name bevat achat. umiddehanach liftur, hanach name liftur.

Metivi: zar sheshshimmesh beshabbat, uvaal mum sheshshimmesh betumea — yesh kan mishshum zarut, umishshum shabbat, umishshum baal mum, umishshum tumea, divre rabbi yose. rabbi shimon omer: en kan ella mishshum zarut uvaal mum bilvad. veillu melika shayyeyra.

Leman shayyeyra? ilema lerabbi yose, hasheta rabbi yose beissur kolel michayyayv shetayim — beissur bat achat mibbaya? ella lav lerabbi shimon. uveissur kolel hu defatar, aval beissur bevat achat — michayyayv. teyuveta davar kappara teyuveta.
Zar sheshshimmesh beshabbat, bemay? i bishchita — shechita bezar keshera. vei bekabbala veholacha — tiltul bealma hu.
I behaketara — vehaamar rabbi yose haveara lelav yatzata.
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: bishchitat paro shel kohen gadol, uchedivre haomer shechitat paro shel kohen gadol bezar pesula. i hachi, may irya zar? afillu kohen hedyot name! shezzar etzlo kaamar.
Matkef la rav ashe: midde chattaot katane, o lave katane?! ella issure bealma ka chashev. lemay nafka minna? lekovro ben reshaim gemurim.

Mishna shenayim shekkiddeshu shete nashim, uvishat kenisatan lachuppa hechlifu et shel ze laze veet shel ze laze — hare ellu chayyayvin mishshum eshet ish. veim hayu achin — mishshum eshet ach. veim hayu achayot — mishshum "ishsha el achotah". veim hayu niddot — mishshum nidda.
Umafrishin otan shelosha chodashim, shemma meubbarot hen. veim hayu ketannot sheenan reuyot leled — machazirim otan miyyad. veim hayu kohanot, nifselu min hatteruma.
Gemara hechlifu. midde berashshie askinan?! vetu, ha detane rabbi chiyyay: hare kan shesh esre chattaot — i bemezid mi ikka korban? amar rav yehuda: teni "huchelfu".
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: im hayu ketannot sheenan reuyot leled — machazirin otan miyyad. vei bemezid, mi sharya? ha la kashya: pittuy ketanna ones ninhu, veones beyisrael mishra shere.
Ella dekatane: mafrishin otan shelosha chodashim shemma meubbarot hen. ha lav meubbarot — sharyayn, vei bemezid mi shere? ella lav, shema minna huchelfu. shema minna.

a: Uman hay tanna deit leh issur kolel veissur mosif veissur bat achat?
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: rabbi meir hi. detanya: yesh ochel achila achat vechayyayv aleha arba chattaot veasham echad.
Tame sheachal chelev, vehu notar min mukedashin, beyom hakkippurim.
Rabbi meir omer: im hayta shabbat vehotzio befiv — chayyayv. amru lo: eno min hashshem.
Verabbi meir allibba deman? i allibba derabbi yehoshua, haamar: taa bidvar mitzva — patur. ella allibba derabbi eliezer.
Ibbaet ema: leolam allibba derabbi yehoshua, ki kaamar rabbi yehoshua taa bidvar mitzva patur, hane mille gabbe tinokot — dizmanno bahul, aval hay, kevan deen zemanno bahul — la.
Vahare teruma, deen zemanno bahul, vekafatar! ditnan: haya ochel bitruma, venoda shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza, rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vachomesh, verabbi yehoshua poter.
Ha ittemar ala, amar rav bivi bar abbaye: hacha bitruma beerev happesach askinan — dizmannah bahul.
Vei baet ema: beissur bat achat, veallibba derabbi shimon.
Bishlama kullehu mashkachat lehu: deshavvinhu shaliach, veshauo inhu shaliach, ufega shaliach beshaliach. ella niddut hechi mashkachat la?
Amar rav amram amar rav: beshofot mittoch shelosha asar leachar shelosha asar — leichayyove inhu, mittoch shenem asar leachar shenem asar — lechayyove inhi.

Mafrishim otan. veha en ishsha mitabberet bevia rishona! amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: shebbaalu veshanu. veella ha detane rabbi chiyyay: hare kan shesh esre chattaot, telatin vetarten havyayn!
Velitamaych — lerabbi eliezer, dimchayyev al kol koach vachoach — tuva havyayn. ella divchoach rishon kachashev, hachi name, devia rishona kachashev.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman:
b: Veha tamar bevia rishona iabbara! amar leh: tamar beetzba miacha. deamar rabbi yitzchak: kol moochot shel bet rabbi — tamar sheman, velamma nikra sheman tamar — al shem tamar shemmiacha beetzbaah. veha havo er veonan! er veonan shimmeshu shello kedarkan.
Metivi: kol esrim vearbaa chodesh dash mibbifnim vezore mibbachutz, divre rabbi eliezer. amru lo: hallalu eno ella kemaase er veonan!
Kemaase er veonan, velo kemaase er veonan. kemaase er veonan, dichtiv: "vehaya im ba el eshet achiv veshichet artza". velo kemaase er veonan, deillu hatam shello kedarkah, vehacha kedarkah.

Bishlama onan, dichtiv beh "veshichet artza", ella er menalan? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: dichtiv "vayyamet gam oto", af hu beotah mita met. bishlama onan, mishshum "lo lo yihye hazzara", ella er may tama avad hachi? kede shello titabber veyachchish yafyah.

Tanu rabbanan: "otah", perat lechalla, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: perat leshello kedarkah. amar leh hun bereh derav nachman lerav nachman: lema ka savar rabbi yehuda hattora chasa al tachshite challa? amar leh: lefi sheen ishsha mitabberet mibbia rishona.
Bemay kamippalgi — rabbanan savri: "shichvat zara", perat lehaaraa. "otah", perat leshello kedarkah. verabbi yehuda savar: shello kedarkah vehaaraa mishshichvat zara" nafka. "otah" — perat lechalla.

Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: kol sheshshahata achar baalah eser shanim venisset — shuv enah yoledet. amar rav nachman: lo shanu ella sheen datah lehinnase, aval datah lehinnase — mitabberet. amar leh rava levat rav chisda: ka meranneni rabbanan abbatricha! amara leh: ana datay alach havay.
Hahi daatay lekammeh derav yosef, amra lo: rabbi, (ana) [ani] shahiti achar bali eser shanim veyaladti! amar la: bitti, al totzii laaz al divre chachamim! amara leh: legoy nivalti.
Amar shemuel: vechullan — tzerichot lehametin shelosha chodashim, chutz miggiyyoret umeshuchereret ketanna. aval ketanna bat yisrael tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim.

Uvemay? i bemeun, vehaamar shemuel dela baaya, vei beget — haamra shemuel chada zimna? deamar shemuel: meana bo — enah tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim, natan lah get — tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim! ella biznut,

a: Ugezaru rabbanan ketanna mishshum gedola.

Umi gazrinan ketanna mishshum gedola? vehatnan: im hayu ketannot sheenan reuyot leled — machzirin otan miyyad. amar rav giddel amar rav: horaat shaa hayta. mikkelal dahavay? ella: kehoraat shaa hayta. vechilluf la shechiach.

Lishshana acharina, amri la amar shemuel: kullan tzerichot lehametin shelosha chodashim, chutz miggiyyoret umeshuchereret gedola. [aval] ketanna bat yisrael enah tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim. bemay? i bemeun — haamra shemuel chada zimna. i beget — ha kaamar shemuel devaaya! deamar shemuel: meana bo — enah tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim! natan lah get — tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim! ella biznut, uzenut biktanna la shechiach.

Giyyoret umeshuchereret dishchiach behu zenut, ligzor! hu deamar kerabbi yose. detanya: haggiyyoret vehashshevuya vehashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeyru veshennishtachreru — tzerichot lehametin shelosha chodashim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose mattir leares velinnase miyyad. amar rabba: may tama derabbi yose — kasavar ishsha mezanna meshammeshet bemoch kede shello titabber.

Amar leh abbaye: bishlama giyyoret, kevan dedata leiggayyore, menattera nafsha, kede lehavechin ben zera shennizra bikdushsha, uven zera shennizra shello bikdushsha. shevuya veshifcha name, deshami mimmarayyhu, umenatteri nafshayyhu. ella yotzet beshen vaayin hechi mashkachat la?
Vechi tema: kol demimmela mode rabbi yose — vehatnan: anusa umefutta tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose mattir leares velinnase miyyad.
Ella amar abbaye: ishsha mezanna, mithappechet shello titabber. veiddach? chayyshinan shemma lo nithappecha yafe yafe.
Veim hayu kohanot kulei. kohanot — in, yisreeliyyot — la! ema: im hayu neshe chohanim. neshe chohanim — in, neshe yisreelim — la.
Vehaamar rav amram: ha milleta amar lan rav sheshet, veanharinhu leayynin mimmatnitin: eshet yisrael shenneensa, af al pi shemmutteret levalah — pesula lakkehunna.
Amar rava, hachi kaamar: im hayu kohanot nesuot leyisrael — nifselu min hatteruma deve nashayyhu.
Hadaran alach arbaa achin
b: Hacholetz livimto venimtzet meubberet veyalda, bizman shehavvalad shel kayyayma — hu muttar bikrovoteha, vehi mutteret bikrovav, velo pesalah min hakkehunna.
En havvalad shel kayyayma — hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura bikrovav, ufesalah min hakkehunna.
Hakkones et yevimto venimtzet meubberet veyalda, bizman shehavvalad shel kayyayma — yotzi, vechayyayvin bekorban.
Veim en valad shel kayyayma — yekayyem.
Safek ben tisha larishon, safek ben shiva laacharon — yotzi, vehavvalad kasher. vechayyayvin beasham taluy.
Gemara ittemar: hacholetz limubberet vehippila, rabbi yochanan amar: enah tzericha chalitza min haachin. resh lakish amar: tzericha chalitza min haachin.

Rabbi yochanan amar: enah tzericha chalitza min haachin, chalitzat meubberet — shemah chalitza, uviat meubberet — shemah bia. veresh lakish amar: tzericha chalitza min haachin, chalitzat meubberet — lo shemah chalitza, uviat meubberet — lo shemah bia.
Bemay kamippalgi? ibbaet ema kera, veibbaet ema sevara.
Ibbaet ema sevara, rabbi yochanan savar: im yavo eliyyahu veyomar deha deiabbara appole mappela, mi lav bat chalitza veyibbum hi? hasheta name tiggalle milleta lemafrea.
Veresh lakish amar: tiggalle milleta lemafrea la amrinan.
Veibbaet ema kera, rabbi yochanan savar: "uven en lo" amar rachamana, veha let leh. veresh lakish savar: "uven en lo" — ayyen alav.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: en havvalad shel kayyayma — hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura bikrovav, ufesalah min hakkehunna. bishlama ledidi, deamena chalitzat meubberet shemah chalitza — mishshum hachi pasla, ella ledidach, deamrat chalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza, ammay pasla min hakkehunna?
Amar leh: midderabbanan, ulechumera bealma.

Ikka deamri: etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: en havvalad shel kayyayma — hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura bikrovav, ufesalah min hakkehunna. bishlama ledidi, deamena chalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza, hayeynu dekatane "pesalah min hakkehunna" — lechumera, vela katane "enah tzericha chalitza min haachin".
Ella ledidach, "enah tzericha chalitza min haachin" mibbee leh! amar leh: in hachi name. veayyeyde ditna resha "lo pesalah" — tena [name] sefa "pesalah".

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: en havvalad shel kayyayma — yekayyem. bishlama ledidi, deamena chalitzat meubberet — shemah chalitza, uviat meubberet — shemah bia, mishshum hachi katane "yekayyem".
Ella ledidach, deamrat chalitzat meubberet — lo shemah chalitza, uviat meubberet — lo shemah bia, "yachzor veyivol vikayyem" mibbee leh! may "yekayyem" — yachzor veyivol vikayyem, dela saggi.

Ikka deamri: etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: en havvalad shel kayyayma — yekayyem. bishlama ledidi, deamena chalitzat meubberet — lo shemah chalitza, uviat meubberet — lo shemah bia, hayeynu dekatane "yekayyem", "yachzor veyivol vikayyem", dela saggi belav hachi,
Ella ledidach — "ratza yotzi, ratza yekayyem" mibbee leh! in hachi name, ayyeyde ditna resha "yotzi", tena name sefa "yekayyem".

Metivi: hakkones et yevimto venimtzet meubberet — hare zo lo tinnase tzaratah, shemma yehe velad ben kayyayma. adderabba, ki have havvalad ben kayyayma, mippatra tzaratah! ella ema: shemma lo yehe havvalad ben kayyayma.
Vei salka datach biat meubberet shemah bia, ammay lo tinnase tzaratah? tippetar bevia shel chavertah!
Amar abbaye: bevia kulle alma la peligi dela patra, ki peligi bachalitza.
Rabbi yochanan savar: chalitzat meubberet — shemah chalitza, biat meubberet — lo shemah bia. resh lakish savar: biat meubberet lo shemah bia, vachalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza.
Amar leh rava, ma nafshach: i biat meubberet shemah bia — chalitzat meubberet shemah chalitza. vei biat meubberet lo shemah bia — chalitzat meubberet name lo shemah chalitza. deha kayyma lan,

a: Dechol haole leyibbum — ole lachalitza, vechol sheen ole leyibbum — eno ole lachalitza.

Ella amar rava, hachi kaamar: hakkones yevimto venimtzet meubberet — hare zo lo tinnase tzaratah, shemma yehe valad ben kayyayma. uviat meubberet lo shemah bia, vachalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza. vehavvalad eno poter ad sheyyetze laavir haolam.

Tanya kevoteh derava: hakkones yevimto venimtzet meubberet — hare zo lo tinnase tzaratah, shemma yehe valad ben kayyayma, veen bia vachalitza poteret, ella valad poter. vehavvalad en potrah ad sheyyetze laavir haolam.
Tama deshemma yehe valad ben kayyayma hu, ha la have valad ben kayyayma mippatra tzaratah, lema tehve teyuveta deresh lakish!

Amar lach resh lakish, hachi katane: hakkones yevimto venimtzet meubberet — hare zo lo tinnase tzaratah, shemma lo yehe havvalad ben kayyayma, vachalitzat meubberet lo shemah chalitza, uviat meubberet lo shemah bia.
Veim tomar: hallech achar rov nashim, verov nashim valad mealleya yaldan, valad en poter ad sheyyetze laavir haolam.

Amar rabbi elazar: efshar ita leha deresh lakish vela tenan lah bematnitin? nefak, dak veashkach, ditnan: haishsha shehalach balah vetzaratah limdinat hayyam, uvau veamru lah "met balich" — hare zo lo tinnase velo tityaybem ad shetteda shemma meubberet hi tzaratah.
Bishlama yabbome la — shemma yehe valad ben kayyayma, veyifga beissur eshet ach deorayyta, ella: lo tachlotz, ammay? bishlama tachlotz betoch tisha vetinnase betoch tisha — la, hayeynu safek.
Ella tachlotz betoch tisha, vetinnase leachar tisha.
Uletamaych: tachlotz vetinnase leachar tisha!
Ella, bar minna dehahi. deabbaye bar abba verav chinnana bar abbaye deamri tarvayyhu: shemma yehe valad ben kayyayma, venimtza atta matzrichah karoz lakkehunna.
Velatzrecha! dilma ikka inish dehave bachalitza vela have behacheraza, veate lememar: kashare chalutza lechohen.
Amar leh abbaye: midde "lo tachlotz velo tityaybem" katane? "lo tinnase velo tityaybem" katane, belo chalitza, aval i chaletz la — hachi name desharya.
Tanya kevoteh deresh lakish: hacholetz limubberet vehippila — tzericha chalitza min haachin.
Amar rava: hilcheta kevoteh deresh lakish behane telat: chada — ha daamaran. iddach, ditnan: hamechallek nechasav al piv, ribba leechad umiet leechad, vehishva lahem et habbechor — devarav kayyaymin.
Veim amar mishshum yerushsha — lo amar kelum. katav, ben battechilla ben bassof ben baemtza, mishshum mattana — devarav kayyaymin.
b: Veamar resh lakish — leolam lo kana ad sheyyomar "peloni ufeloni yirshu sade pelonit ufelonit shennetattim lahem bemattana veyirashum".

Veiddach, ditnan: hakkotev kol nechasav livno leachar moto, haav eno yachol limkor — mippene shennetanan labben, vehabben eno yachol limkor — mippene shehen birshut haav. machar haav — mechurin ad sheyyamut hu, machar habben — en lallokeach kelum ad sheyyamut haav.
Veittemar: machar habben bechayye haav, umet habben bechayye haav. rabbi yochanan amar: lo kana lokeach, veresh lakish amar: kana lokeach.
Rabbi yochanan amar lo kana lokeach — kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame.
Veresh lakish amar kana lokeach — kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame.
En havvalad shel kayyayma kulei. tana: mishshum rabbi eliezer amru — yotzi beget.
Amar rava: rabbi meir verabbi eliezer amru davar echad: rabbi eliezer ha daamaran.
Rabbi meir detanya: lo yissa adam meubberet chavero, umeneket chavero. veim nasa — yotzi velo yachzir olamit, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: yotzi, velichsheyyaggia zemanno lichnos — yichnos.
Amar leh abbaye: mimmay? dilma la hi, ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hacha, ella mishshum dekafage beissur eshet ach deorayyta, aval hatam derabbanan — kerabbanan sevira leh!
I name: ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam, ella mishshum derabbanan, vachachamim asu chizzuk ledivrehem yoter mishshel tora, aval hacha middeorayyta — mifrash parshi minna.
Amar rava, uledivre chachamim: yotziah beget. amar mar zutera: dayka name, dekatane: "yotzi", vela katane: "yafrish". shema minna.
Amar leh rav ashe lerav hoshaya bereh derav idi: hatam tenan, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol sheshshaha beadam sheloshim yom — eno nefel. ha la sheha — sefeka have.
Veittemar: met betoch sheloshim yom, veamda venitkaddesha,
Ravina mishshemeh derava amar: im eshet yisrael hi — choletzet, veim eshet kohen hi — enah choletzet.
Rav mesharsheya mishshemeh derava amar: achat zo veachat zo — choletzet.
Amar leh ravina lerav mesharsheya:

a: Beureta amar rava hachi, uvetzafra hadar beh. amar leh: sherituha? yehe raava detish(t)ro af tarba.
Hacha gabbe meubberet chavero umeneket chavero hannesua lechohen, may? mi avud rabbanan takkanta lechohen, o la.

Amar leh: hachi hasheta? bishlama hatam, kevan deikka rabbanan difligi aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel, deamri: af al gav dela sheha valad mealleya have, gabbe eshet kohen kevan dela efshar — avdinan kerabbanan,
Aval hacha, keman naaved? i kerabbi meir, ha amar: yotzi velo yachzir olamit, vei kerabbanan — haamri beget.
Ittemar: kiddeshah betoch shelosha uvarach, peligi ba rav acha verafram, chad amar: meshammetinan leh, vechad amar: erukeh missatyeh. hava ovada vaamar lehu rafram: erukeh missatyeh.
Safek ben tesha vechulei. amar leh rava lerav nachman: lema hallech achar rov nashim, verov nashim letisha yaldan!
Amar leh: neshe didan, leshiva yaldan. amar leh: neshe didchu havu rubba dealma?
Amar leh, hachi kaamena: rov nashim yaldan letisha, umiut leshiva, vechol hayyoledet letisha, ubbarah nikkar lishlish yameha. vezo, hoil velo hukkar ubbarah lishlish yameha — ittera leh rubba.

I kol hayyoledet letisha ubbarah nikkar lishlish yameha, ha middelo hukkar lishlish yameha, ubbarah vadday bar shiva levatraa hu! ella ema: rov hayyoledet letisha — ubbarah nikkar lishlish yameha, vehay middelo hukkar lishlish yameha — ittera leh rubba.
Tanu rabbanan: rishon rauy lihyot kohen gadol, vesheni mamzer missafek. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: en mamzer missafek.
May kaamar? amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: rishon rauy lihyot kohen gadol, vesheni sefek mamzer, veasur bemamzeret. rabbi eliezer omer: eno sefek mamzer, ella vadday mamzer, umuttar bemamzeret.

Rava amar, hachi kaamar: rishon rauy lihyot kohen gadol, vesheni mamzer vadday missafek umuttar bemamzeret. verabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: en vadday mamzer missafek. ella sefek mamzer, veasur bemamzeret.
Vekamippalgi bidrabbi elazar. ditnan, rabbi elazar omer: vaddaan bevaddaan — muttar, vaddaan bisfekan, usefekan bevaddaan, usefekan bisfekan — asur.
Veellu hen sefekan: shetuki vaasufi vechuti.

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: halacha kerabbi elazar. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: hillel shana — asara yuchasin alu mibbavel: kahane, leviyye, veyisreele, chalale, gere, charore, mamzere, netine, shetuke vaasufe. vechullan muttarin lavo ze baze.
Veat amrat halacha kerabbi elazar!
Abbaye savar la kishmuel, deamar: halacha kehillel, umoke la rabbi eliezer ben yaakov allibba dehilcheta, ki hechi dela tikshe hilcheta ahilcheta.
Rava savar la kerav, deamar: halacha kerabbi elazar. umoke la lidrabbi eliezer ben yaakov allibba dehilcheta, ki hechi dela tikshe
b: Hilcheta ahilcheta.
Amar abbaye: mena amena la dechol sefeka lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov — kevadday meshavve leh,

Detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: hare shebba al nashim harebe veen yodea al ezo mehen ba, vechen hi shebbau aleha anashim harebe, veenah yodaat meeze mehen kibbela — nimtza av nose et bitto, veach nose et achoto, venitmalle kol haolam kullo mamzerin. veal ze neemar: "umala haaretz zimma".
Verava amar lach, hachi kaamar: "zo ma hi".
Yater al ken, amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: lo yissa adam ishsha bimdina zo veyelech veyissa ishsha bimdina acheret, shemma yizdavvevgu ze laze, venimtza ach nose et achoto.
Ini? veha rav ki ikkela ledardeshir, [machrez] veamar: man havya leyoma. verav nachman ki ikkela leshachnetziv, [machrez] veamar: man havya leyoma!
Shane rabbanan, difkia shemayyhu.
Vehaamar rava: tevauha linnase venitpayyeysa — tzericha leshev shiva nekiyyim?
Rabbanan sheluchayyhu havo meshadderi umodi lehu. veibbaet ema: lerabbanan, yachode bealma hu dimyaychadi lehu, deamar mar: eno dome mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo lemi sheen lo pat besallo.
Tana, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: lo yissa adam ishto vedato legarshah, mishshum shenneemar: "al tacharosh al reacha raa vehu yoshev lavetach ittach".
Safek veyavam shebbau lachalok benichse mitana,
Safek amar: ana bar mitana hu, venichse didi (hu) [ninhu]. veyavam amar: at beray didi at, velet lach vela midde benichse. have mamon hammuttal besafek, umamon hammuttal besafek — cholkin.
Safek uvene yavam shebbau lachalok benichse mitana, safek amar: hahu gavra bar mitana hu, venichse didi (hu) [ninhu]. bene yavam amri: at (achenu) [achuna] at, umenata hu deit lach bahadan.
Sevur rabbanan kammeh derav mesharsheya lememar: matnitin hi, ditnan: hu eno yoresh otam, vehem yorshin oto.
Vehacha ippecha. hatam amri leh: ayyti reaya ushekol,
Hacha amar lehu: ayyto reaya ushekulu.
Amar lehu rav mesharsheya: mi dame? hatam, inhu vadday veihu safek. hacha, idde veidde safek.
Ella, i damya lematnitin — [leha] damya: lesafek uvene yavam shebbau lachlok benichse yavam gufeh, dehatam amri leh: ayyti reaya daachuna at ushekol.
Safek uvene yavam shebbau lachlok benichse yavam, levatar diflag yavam benichse mitana,
Bene yavam amri: ayyti reaya daachuna at ushekol. amar lehu safek: ma nafshayychu, i achuchon ana — havu li menata bahadayychu, vei bar mitana ana — havu li palga diflag avuchon bahaday.
Rabbi abba amar rav: kam dina. rabbi yirmeya amar: hadar dina.

Lema biflugeta deadmon verabbanan kamippalgi, ditnan: mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veavda lo derech sadehu — admon amar: yelech biktzara. vachachamim omrim: yikkach lo derech bemea mane, o yifrach baavir.
Vehavenan ba: lerabbanan shappir kaamar admon? veamar rav yehuda amar rav: hacha bemay askinan — kegon shehikkifuha arbaa bene adam mearba ruchot.
I hachi, may tama deadmon? veamar rava: bearbea deatu mikkoach arbea, vearbea deatu mikkoach chad — kulle alma la peligi dematzu medache leh.

Ki peligi, bechad deate mikkoach arbea. admon savar, matze amar leh: mikkol makom darkay gabbach hu. verabbanan savri daamar leh: i shatkat — shatkat, vei la, mahdarna shetara lemarayyhu, vela matzet leishtaoye dina bahadayyhu.
Lema rabbi abba deamar kerabbanan.
Verabbi yirmeya deamar keadmon.
Amar lach rabbi abba: ana daamari afillu keadmon, ad kan la kaamar admon hatam, ella mishshum deamar leh: mimma nafshach

a: Darkay (chad gabbach) [gabbe chad] hu. aval hacha, mi ikka lememar hachi?

Verabbi yirmeya amar lach: ana daamari afillu lerabbanan, ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam, ella mishshum deamar leh: i shatkat — shatkat. vei la, mahdarna shetara lemarayyhu vela matzet leishtaoye dina bahadayyhu, aval hacha — mi ikka lememar hachi?
Safek veyavam shebbau lachalok benichse sava. safek amar: hay gavra bar mitana hu, ufalga didi hu. yavam amar: at, beray didi at, velet lach vela midde.
Have yavam vadday, vesafek safek, veen safek motzi mide vadday.
Safek uvene yavam shebbau lachalok benichse sava. safek amar: hahu gavra bar mitana hu, ufalga didi hu. uvene yavam amri: achuna at umenata it lach bahadan.
Palga dekamode lehu — shakli. tilta deka modu leh — shakel. pash lehu danka — have mamon hammuttal besafek vecholkin.
Sava veyavam benichse safek. o sava vesafek benichse yavam —
Have mamon hammuttal besafek vecholkin.
Mishna shomeret yavam shennaflu lah nechasim — modim bet shammay uvet hillel shemmocheret venotenet, vekayyaym.

Meta, ma yaase bichtubbatah, uvinchasim hannichnasim veyotzin immah? bet shammay omrim: yachloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav. uvet hillel omrim: nechasim bechezkatan. ketubba — bechezkat yorshe habbaal, nechasim hannichnasim veyotzin immah — bechezkat yorshe haav.
Kenasah — hare hi keishto lechol davar. uvilvad shettehe ketubba[ta] al nichse balah harishon.
Gemara may shena resha dela peligi, umay shena sefa difligi?
Amar ulla: resha denafla keshehi arusa, vesefa denafla keshehi nesua.
Vekasavar ulla: zikkat arusa osa sefek arusa,
b: Zikkat nesua osa sefek nesua.
Zikkat arusa osa sefek arusa — dei salka datach vadday arusa, modim bet hillel shemmocheret venotenet vekayyaym?

Vehatnan: naflu lah nechasim mishshennitarsa, bet shammay omrim: timkor, uvet hillel omrim: lo timkor. ellu veellu modim sheim machra venatna — kayyaym. ella shema minna: zikkat arusa osa sefek arusa.
Zikkat nesua osa sefek nesua. dei salka datach vadday nesua, bet shammay omrim yachloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav?
Vehatnan: naflu lah nechasim mishshennisset, ellu vaellu modim sheim machra venatna — shehabbaal motzi miyyad hallakochot. ella shema minna: zikkat nesua osa sefek nesua.
Amar leh rabba: addemippalgi begufa uleachar mita, lippalgu bechayyeha uleferot!
Ella amar rabba: idde veidde denafla keshehi nesua, vezikkat nesua osa sefek nesua. resha deihi kayyma — havya la ihi vadday veinhu safek, veen safek motzi mide vadday.
Sefa demeta, hallalu bain lirash, vehallalu bain lirash — veyachloku.
Etiveh abbaye: ulevet shammay en safek motzi mide vadday? vehatnan: nafal habbayit alav veal aviv, alav veal morishav, vehayu alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov.
Yorshe haav omrim: habben met rishon, veachar kach met haav, uvaal chov omer: haav met rishon, veachar kach met habben —
Bet shammay omrim: yachloku, uvet hillel omrim: nechasim bechezkatan.
Veha hacha, yorshe haav vadday, uvaal chov safek, vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday!
Kasavri bet shammay: shetar haomed ligbot kegavuy dame.
Umena temra, ditnan: metu baalehen ad shello shatu — bet shammay omrim: notlot ketubbatan veenan shotot. uvet hillel omrim: o shotot o lo notlot ketubbatan.
O shotot?! "vehevi haish et ishto" amar rachamana, velekka! ella: mittoch shello shotot lo notlot ketubbatan.
Veha hacha, desafek hu: safek zannay safek la zannay, vekaate safek umotzi mide vadday! ella shema minna: shetar haomed ligbot kegavuy dame.
Veabbaye, lotveh meha! dilma ketubbat ishsha shane, mishshum chinna.
Velotveh ketubba dematnitin!
La peligi. vela?! veha katane: meta, ma yaase bichtubbatah uvinchasim hannichnasim veyotzin immah — bet shammay omrim: yachloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav, uvet hillel omrim: nechasim bechezkatan.
Hachi kaamar: meta, ma yaase bichtubbatah, veshavka. nechasim hannichnasim vehayyotzim immah — bet shammay omrim: yachloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav, uvet hillel omrim: nechasim bechezkatan.
Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka — dekatane: yachloku yorshe habbaal im yorshe haav. vela katane: yorshe haav im yorshe habbaal. shema minna.
Abbaye amar: resha denaflu lah keshehi shomeret yavam, sefa denaflu lah keshehi tachtav devaal.

a: Vekasavar abbaye yado keyadah.
Amar leh rava: i denafli lah keshehi tachtav devaal — dechulle alma la peligi deyado adifa miyyadah.
Ella idde veidde denaflu lah keshehi shomeret yavam. resha dela avad ba maamar, sefa daavad ba maamar.
Vekasavar rava maamar levet shammay ose vadday arusa usefek nesua. vadday arusa — lidchot batztzara, usefek nesua — lachlok bannechasim.
Ittemar mishshemeh derabbi elazar kevoteh derava, veittemar mishshemeh derabbi yose berabbi chanina kevoteh deabbaye.
Umi amar rabbi elazar hachi? veha amar rabbi elazar: maamar levet shammay eno kone ella lidchot batztzara bilvad!
Efoch. vei baet ema: leolam la tefoch — amar lach rabbi elazar: ki amari ana, dela saggi la beget ella devae name chalitza. lachlok bannechasim dela kane — mi amari?
Amar rav pappa: diyyuka dematnitin kevoteh deabbaye, veaf al gav dekashya "meta".
Dekatane: nechasim hannichnasim veyotzim immah, may "nichnasin" umay "yotzin"? lav "nichnasin" — lirshut habbaal, veyotzim" — mershut habbaal lirshut haav,
Veaf al gav dekashya "meta", addemippalgi begufa uleachar mita, lippalgu bechayyeha uleferot.
Vetu la midde.
Kenasah hare hi kulei. lemay hilcheta? amar rabbi yose bar chanina: lomar shemmegarsha beget umachzirah.
Megarsha beget, peshita? salka datach amena, hoil uchetiv: "ulekachah lo leishsha veyibbemah" — amar rachamana: vaadayin yibbume harishon aleha, bachalitza — in, beget — la, ka mashma lan.
Machzirah. peshita? salka datach amena, mitzva deramya rachamana aleh — avda, hasheta tekum aleh beissur eshet ach, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name? amar kera: "ulekachah lo leishsha", kevan shellekachah — hare hi keishto lechol davar.
Uvilvad shettehe ketubbatah kulei. may tama — ishsha hiknu lo min hashshamayim.
Vei let la min harishon — takkinu la mishsheni, kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah.
Mishna mitzva begadol leyaybem. lo ratza — mehallechin al kol haachin. lo ratzu — chozrin etzel gadol veomrim lo, alecha mitzva: o chalotz, o yaybem.
Tala bekatan ad sheyyagdil, o baggadol ad sheyyavo mimmedinat hayyam, o cheresh o shote — en shomin lo, ella omrim lo: alecha mitzva, o chalotz o yaybem.
Gemara ittemar: biat katan, vachalitzat gadol — peligi ba rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi, chad amar: biat katan adifa, vechad amar: chalitzat gadol adifa.
Man deamar biat katan adifa — deha mitzva beyibbum. uman deamar chalitzat gadol adifa: bimkom gadol — biat katan lav kelum hi.
Tenan: lo ratza — machzirin al kol haachin. may lav: lo ratza leyaybem ella lachlotz, vekatane: mehallechin etzel haachin, shema minna biat katan adifa!

La, lo ratza lachlotz velo leyaybem, dichvota gabbe haachin: lo ratzu lo lachlotz velo leyaybem. ammay chozrim etzel haggadol? lemichpeyeh (lichpeyeh) [lichpinhu] ledidhu! kevan demitzva aleh dideh ramya — ledideh kayyfinan.
Tenan: tala bekatan ad sheyyagdil en shomin lo. vei biat katan adifa, ammay en shomin lo? nintar dilma gadel umeyaybem!
Velitamaych, uvegadol ad sheyyavo mimmedinat hayyam en shomin lo, ammay? nintar dilma ate vechaletz? ella kol shahoye mitzva la meshahenan.
b: It deamri: bevia, kulle alma la peligi deviat katan adifa. ki peligi bachalitzat katan.
Vehachi ittemar: chalitzat katan vachalitzat gadol, peligi ba rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi. chad amar: chalitzat gadol adifa, vechad amar: ki hadade ninhu.
Man deamar chalitzat gadol adifa — deha mitzva baggadol. veiddach — ki amrinan mitzva baggadol leinyan yibbum, aval leinyan chalitza — kahadade ninhu.
Tenan: lo ratzu — chozrin etzel gadol. may lav: lo ratzu leyaybem, ella lachlotz. vekatane: chozrin etzel gadol, ushema minna chalitzat gadol adifa!

La, lo ratzu lo lachlotz vela leyaybem, dichvoteh gabbe gadol: lo ratza lo lachlotz velo leyaybem. ella ammay chozrin etzel gadol? lemichpeyeh (lichpeyuyhu) [nichpinhu] ledidhu! kevan demitzva aleh dideh ramya — ledideh kayyfinan.
Ta shema: tala baggadol ad sheyyavo mimmedinat hayyam — en shomin lo. vei salka datach chalitzat gadol adifa, ammay en shomin lo? nintar dilma ate vechaletz!
Uletamaych, bekatan ad sheyyagdil, en shomin lo — ammay? nintar dilma gadel umeyaybem. (i name ate ihu umeyaybma.) ella: kol shahoye mitzva la meshahenan.
Tenan hatam: mitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza. barishona, shehayu mitkavvevnin leshem mitzva. achshav sheen mitkavvevnin leshem mitzva, amru: mitzvat chalitza kodemet lemitzvat yibbum.
Amar rav: en kofin. ki ato lekammeh derav, amar lehu: i baet — chalotz, i baet — yaybem. bedidach tela rachamana: "veim lo yachpotz haish", ha im chafetz, i bae — chaletz, i bae — yeyabbem.

Veaf rav yehuda savar en kofin. middeatken rav yehuda begitta dachalitza: ech pelonit bat peloni akrivat yat peloni yevama kodamana leve dina, veishtemodinhu daachu demitana meabba nihu, veamri leh: i tzavet leyabbem — yabbem, vei la — aytla la riglaych deyammina.
Veaytla la rigla deyammina, usherat seneh maal raglohi, virakat beanpohi rukka demitchazya leve dina al ara.
Verabbi chiyyay bar avya mesayyem ba mishshemeh derav yehuda: veakrinhu ma dichtiv bisfar orayyta demoshe.
Ishtemodinhu, peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad amar: beedim, vechad amar: afillu karov, afillu ishsha. vehilcheta: galloye milleta vealma hu, vaafillu karov vaafillu ishsha.
Barishona, shehayu mitkavvevnin leshem mitzva — mitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza. veachshav sheen mitkavvevnin leshem mitzva, amru: mitzvat chalitza kodemet lemitzvat yibbum.
Amar rame bar chama amar rabbi yitzchak: chazru lomar mitzvat yibbum kodemet lemitzvat chalitza. amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak: ikkashshur dare?
Meikkara savri la keabba shaul, ulevassof savri la kerabbanan.

Detanya, abba shaul omer: hakkones et yevimto leshem noy, uleshum ishut, uleshum davar acher — keillu pogea beerva. vekarov ani beenay lihyot havvalad mamzer. vachachamim omrim: "yevamah yavo aleha", mikkol makom.

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: "yevamah yavo aleha" — mitzva! shebbattechilla hayta alav bichlal hetter. neesra, vechazra vehuttera, yachol tachzor lehetterah harishon — talmud lomar: "yevamah yavo aleha", mitzva.

Man tanna? amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: abba shaul hi. vehachi kaamar: "yevamah yavo aleha", mitzva. shebbattechilla hayta alav bichlal hetter. ratza leshem noy — konsah, ratza leshum ishut — konsah.
Neesra, chazra vehuttera. yachol tachzor lehetterah harishon — talmud lomar: "yevamah yavo aleha", lemitzva.
Rava amar: afillu tema rabbanan, vehachi kaamar: "yevamah yavo aleha", mitzva. shebbattechilla hayta bichlal hetter. ratza konsah, ratza eno konsah.
Neesra, chazra vehuttera. yachol tachzor lehetterah harishon, ratza — konsah, ratza — eno konsah. ratza eno konsah?
Ha agida beh, bichdi tippok? ella ema: ratza — konsah, ratza — choletz lah, talmud lomar: "yevamah yavo aleha", mitzva.
Ema resha: "matztzot teachel bemakom kadosh" — mitzva.

a: Shebbattechilla hayta alav bichlal hetter. neesra, vechazra vehuttera, yachol tachzor lehetterah harishon — talmud lomar: "matztzot teachel bemakom kadosh" — mitzva.

Bishlama lerava deamar ha manni rabbanan hi — hacha, hachi kaamar: "matztzot teachel bemakom kadosh" — mitzva. shebbattechilla hayta alav bichlal hetter, ratza — ochlah, ratza — eno ochlah (neesra, chazra vehuttera, yachol tachzor lehetterah harishon), ratza — ochlah, ratza — eno ochlah.
Ratza eno ochlah?! vehachtiv: "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem", melammed shehakkohanim ochlim uvealim mitkapperin!
Ella: ratza — hu ochlah, ratza — kohen acher ochlah, talmud lomar: "matztzot teachel bemakom kadosh" — mitzva.
Ella lerav yitzchak bar avdimi, deamar abba shaul hi, hacha may tere gavvne ikka?
Vechi tema: ratza — leteavon ochlah, ratza — achila gassa ochlah, achila gassa mi shemah achila? vehaamar resh lakish: haochel achila gassa beyom hakkippurim patur millo teunne"!
Ella: ratza — matztza ochlah, ratza — chametz ochlah.
Vehachtiv: "lo teafe chametz chelkam", veamar resh lakish: vaafillu chelkam lo teafe chametz! ella: ratza — matztza ochlah, ratza — chalut ochlah.
Hay chalut hechi dame? i matztza hi — ha matztza hi, vei la matztza hi — "matztzot" amar rachamana!
La, leolam ema lach matztza hi, ulehachi tena beh kera — leakkev.

Ella chalut matztza hi dekaamrinan, lemay hilcheta? lomar sheadam yotze bah yede chovato befesach, af al pi dechalteh meikkara, kevan dahadar afyeh betannur — "lechem oni" karena beh, veadam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach.

Mishna hacholetz livimto — hare hu keechad min haachin lannachala. veim yesh sham av — nechasim shel av. hakkones et yevimto — zacha binchasim shel achiv. rabbi yehuda omer: ben kach uven kach, im yesh sham av — nechasim shel av.
Gemara peshita! salka datach amena chalitza bimkom yibbum kayyma, venishkol kullehu nichse, ka mashma lan.
I hachi, hare hu keechad min haachim — eno ella keechad min haachim mibbee leh!
Ella, salka datach amena: hoil veafseda miyyibbum, likneseh, ka mashma lan.
Im yesh sham av. deamar mar: av kodem lechol yotze yerecho.
Hakkones et yevimto vechulei. may tama — "yakum al shem achiv" amar rachamana, vahare kam.
Rabbi yehuda omer vechulei. amar ulla: halacha kerabbi yehuda. vechen amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha: halacha kerabbi yehuda.
Veamar ulla, veittema rabbi yitzchak nappacha: may tama derabbi yehuda, dichtiv: "vehaya habbechor asher teled" — kivchor, ma bechor en lo bechayye haav — af hay name en lo bechayye haav.
I: ma bechor notel pi shenayim leachar mitat haav, af hay notel pi shenayim leachar mitat haav!
Midde "yakum al shem aviv" ketiv? "yakum al shem achiv" ketiv, velo "al shem aviv".
Ema: hecha delekka av delishkol nachala — titkayyem mitzvat yibbum, hecha deikka av [dela] shakel nachala — lo titkayyem mitzvat yibbum.
Midde yibbum benachala tela rachamana? yabbome meyabbemi, vei ikka nachala — shakel, vei la — la shakel.
Yetev rabbi chanina kara kammeh derabbi yannay, veyatev vekaamar: halacha kerabbi yehuda. amar leh: pok keri kerayaych levara, en halacha kerabbi yehuda.
Tane tanna, kammeh derav nachman: en halacha kerabbi yehuda. amar leh: ella keman, kerabbanan? peshita, yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim!
Amar leh: esmeyay?! amar leh: la. at — halacha atneyuych, umiksha hu deikkeshi lach, vaafacht. ulemay daafacht, shappir afacht.
Mishna hacholetz livimto — hu asur bikrovoteha, vehi asura bikrovav.
b: Hu asur beimmah, uveem immah, uveem aviha, uvevittah, uvevat bittah, uvevat benah, uvaachotah bizman shehi kayyemet. vehaachin muttarin.
Vehi asura beaviv, uvaavi aviv, uvivno, uveven beno, beachiv, uveven achiv.
Muttar adam bikrovat tzarat chalutzato. veasur betzarat kerovat chalutzato.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: gazru sheniyyot bachalutza, o lo?
Beerva deorayyta — gezaru behu rabbanan sheniyyot, bachalutza — la gezaru rabbanan sheniyyot, o dilma la shena.
Ta shema: hu asur beimmah uveem immah, veillu "em em immah" — la katane!
Dilma hayeynu tama dela tane, mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa "vehaachin muttarin", vei tana "em em immah", hava amena: haachin muttarin davka beem em immah, aval beem immah uveimmah — lo.
Velitne "em em immah", velitne "haachin muttarin bechullan"! kashya.
Ta shema: hi asura beaviv uvaavi aviv. katane miha avi aviv, may lav, mishshum choletz dehavya la kallat beno!
La, mishshum mitana, dehavya la kallat beno.
Ta shema: uveven beno. may lav, mishshum choletz, dehavya la (mishshum) eshet avi aviv!
La, mishshum mitana, vehavya la eshet achi avi aviv.
Ha ammemar machshar beeshet achi avi aviv!
Ammemar moke la bevar bera desava.
I hachi, hayeynu achiv uven achiv? tena achiv min haav, vekatane achiv min haem.
Ta shema, detane rabbi chiyyay: arba middivre tora, vearba middivre sofrim: av uveno, achiv, uven achiv — middivre tora. avi aviv, vaavi immo, ben beno, uven bitto — middivre sofrim
Katane miha avi aviv. may lav, mishshum choletz, vehavya la kallat beno!
La, mishshum mitana, dehavya la kallat beno.
Ta shema: avi immo. may lav, mishshum choletz, dehavya la kallat bitto!
La, mishshum mitana, dehavya la kallat bitto.
Ta shema: uven beno. may lav, mishshum choletz, dehavya la eshet avi aviv!
La, mishshum mitana, vehavya la eshet achi avi aviv.
Veha ammemar machshir beeshet achi avi aviv! ammemar mokem la mishshum choletz, vekasavar gazru sheniyyot bachalutza.
Ta shema: uveven bitto. may lav, mishshum choletz, dehavya la eshet avi immo!
La, mishshum mitana, dehavya la eshet achi avi immo. veha gabbe sheniyyot deerva lo gazru!
Ella lav, mishshum choletz, ushema minna gazru sheniyyot bachalutza? shema minna.
Muttar adam vechulei. amar rav tovi bar kisna amar shemuel: habba al tzarat chalutza — havvalad mamzer. may tama? beissura kayyma.
Amar rav yosef, af anan name tenena: muttar adam bikrovat tzarat chalutzato. i amrat bishlama tzara abbaray, mishshum hachi muttar baachotah.
Ella i amrat tzara kachalutza damya, ammay muttar?
Lema tehve teyuveta derabbi yochanan, deamar: ben hu, ben achin — en chayyayvin lo al hachalutza karet, velo al tzaratah karet.
Amar lach rabbi yochanan: vetisbera achot chalutza deorayyta? vehaamar resh lakish: kan shana rabbi achot gerusha middivre tora, achot chalutza middivre sofrim.
May shena hay, umay shena hay?

a: Hach deazla bahada leve dina, gezaru behu rabbanan. hay dela azla bahada leve dina, la gezaru behu rabbanan.
Mishna hacholetz livimto, venasa achiv et achotah, vamet — choletzet velo mityabbemet. vechen hamegaresh et ishto, venasa achiv et achotah, vamet — hare zo petura.
Shomeret yavam shekkiddesh achiv et achotah — mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betira amru, omrim lo: hameten ad sheyyaase achicha maase.
Chalatz lah achiv o kenasah — yichnos et ishto. meta hayyevama — yichnos et ishto. met yavam — yotzi et ishto beget, veeshet achiv bachalitza.
Gemara may "vechen"? ema: "aval hamegaresh".
Amar resh lakish, kan shana rabbi: achot gerusha middivre tora, achot chalutza middivre sofrim.
Shomeret yavam shekkiddesh vechulei. amar shemuel: halacha kedivre rabbi yehuda ben betera.
Ibbaya lehu: meta ishto, mahu bivimto? rav verabbi chanina deamri tarvayyhu: meta ishto — muttar bivimto. shemuel verav assi deamri tarvayyhu: meta ishto — asur bivimto.
Amar rava: may tama derav — mishshum dahavay yevama shehuttera veneesra, vechazra vehuttera, tachzor lehetterah harishon.
Metiv rav hamenuna: shelosha achin, shenayim nesuin shete achayot, veechad mufene. met echad mibbaale achayot, veasa bah mufene maamar, veachar kach met achiv hashsheni,
Veachar kach meta ishto acharav — otah yevama choletzet velo mityabbemet.
Veammay? tehve kivama shehuttera veneesra vechazra vehuttera, tachzor lehetterah harishon!
Ishtik. levatar dinfak amar: ammay la amart leh, rabbi elazar hi, deamar: kevan sheamda alav shaa achat beissur — neesra alav olamit?
Hadar amar: emor deamar rabbi elazar — hecha dela chazya bishat nefila, aval hecha dechazya bishat nefila, mi amar?
Hadar amar: in, vehatanya, rabbi elazar omer: meta yevimto — muttar beishto, meta ishto — otah yevama choletzet velo mityabbemet.
Lema shemuel verav assi deamri kerabbi elazar?
Afillu tema kerabbanan, ad kan la kamippalgi rabbanan aleh derabbi elazar, ella mishshum deminnefila veelach la mittesar alayyhu, aval hacha deittesar — afillu rabbanan modu.

Mishna hayyevama lo tachalotz velo tityaybem ad sheyyesh lah shelosha chodashim. vechen kol shear hannashim lo yitarsu velo yinnasu ad sheyyehu lahen shelosha chodashim: echad betulot veechad beulot, echad gerushot veechad almanot, echad nesuot veechad arusot.
Rabbi yehuda omer: hannesuot — yitarsu, vehaarusot — yinnasu. chutz min haarusot shebbihuda, mippene shellibbo gas bah.
Rabbi yose omer: kol hannashim yitarsu, chutz min haalmana,
b: Mippene haibbul.
Gemara bishlama lo tityaybem: shemma yihye havvalad ben kayyayma, veka faga beissur eshet ach deorayyta. ella lo tachlotz, ammay?
Lema tehve teyuveta derabbi yochanan, deamar: chalitzat meubberet shemah chalitza. velav mi otvinneh lerabbi yochanan chada zimna?! lema meha name tehve teyuveta!
La, hacha hayeynu tama: shemma yehe valad ben kayyayma, venimtzeta atta matzrichah karoz lakkehunna.
Venatzrecha! dilma ikka dehavey bachalitza vela have behacheraza, umafseluha min hakkehunna.
Tinach almana. gerusha — may ikka lememar? mishshum demafsed la mezonot.
Tinach nesua. arusa gerusha — may ikka lememar?
Ella mishshum derabbi yose, detanya: maase beadam echad shebba lifne rabbi yose. amar lo: mahu lachlotz betoch shelosha? amar lo: lo tachlotz. vetachlotz, uma bechach?
Kara alav mikra ze: "veim lo yachpotz", ha im chafetz — yibbem. kol haole leyibbum — ole lachalitza kulei.
Metiv rav chinnana: hassefekot choltzot velo mityabbemot.
May sefekot? illema sefek kiddushin — ammay la mityabbemot? tityaybem, veen bechach kelum.
Ella lav, safek shekkiddesh achat mishte achayot, veeno yodea ezo mehen kiddesh. vekatane: choletzet!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam, im yavo eliyyahu veyomar deha kiddesh — bat chalitza veyibbum hi,
Hacha, im yavo eliyyahu veyomar deha la iabbara — mi mashgechi[ynan] beh, u[m]yabbeminan la? ha ketanna delav bat iabbore hi, vaafillu hachi tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim.
Tanu rabbanan: yevama, shelosha chodashim harishonim nizzonet mishshel baal. mikkan veelach, enah nizzonet lo mishshel baal velo mishshel yavam.
Amad baddin uvarach — nizzonet mashal yavam.
Nafla lifne yavam katan (may)? miyyavam let la. mibbaal may?
Peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad amar: it la, vechad amar: let la, vehilcheta: let la, mishshemayya kansu.
Tanu rabbanan: yevama shechaltzu lah achim betoch shelosha — tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim.

a: Leachar shelosha — en tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim.
Heve (ha)shelosha chodashim sheamru, mishsheat mitat habbaal, velo mishsheat chalitzat hayyavam.
May shena migget, derav amar: mishsheat netina, ushemuel amar: mishsheat ketiva!
Amar rava, kal vachomer: issur karet hittarta, issur lav — lo kol shekken.
Vechen shear kol hannashim. bishlama yevama, kedaamaran. ella shear kol hannashim ammay?
Amar rav nachman amar shemuel, mishshum deamar kera: "lihyot lecha lelohim ulezaracha acharecha", lehavechin ben zaro shel rishon lezaro shel sheni.
Metiv rava: lefichach ger vegiyyoret tzerichin lehametin shelosha chodashim, hacha may lehavechin ikka?
Hacha name, ikka lehavechin ben zera shennizra bikdushsha lezera shello nizra bikdushsha.
Rava amar: gezera shemma yissa et achoto meaviv, viyabbem eshet achiv meimmo.
Veyotzi et immo lashshuk. veyiftor et yevimto lashshuk.
Metiv rav chananya: bechullan ani kore bahen mishshum takkanat erva, vechan mishshum takkanat valad. veim ita, kullehu mishshum takkanat erva!
Hay mishshum takkanat valad, dela lifga behu erva.
Bishlama tamtin shene chodashim vetinnase — la, dehayynu sefeka: i bar tisha lekamma, i bar shiva levatra.
Ella tamtin chodesh echad vetinnase, vei leshiva yalda — hay bar shiva levatra hu. vei litmanya yalda — hay bar tisha lekamma hu!
I name litmanya yalda, ikka lememar devatra hu. dilma ishtahoye ishtahay chodesh echad veiabbar.
Vetamtin shene chodashim umechetza vetinnase, dei leshiva yalda — hay bar shiva levatra hu, vei leshitta ufalga yalda — hay bar tisha lekamma hu. dei bar batra hu — bar shitta ufalga la chaye!
I name leshitta ufalga yalda, ikka lememar devatra hu, deamar mar zutera: afillu leman deamar yoledet letisha enah yoledet limkuttain, yalda leshiva — yoledet limkuttain.
Shenneemar: "vayhi litkufot hayyamim", miut "tekufot" — shetayim, miut "yamim" — shenayim.
Vetamtin mashshehu vetinnase, vechi malu shelosha chodashim — livdeka!
Amar rav safra: en bodkin et hannesuot, shello yitgannu al baalehen. venivdeka behillucha!
Amar rame bar chama: ishsha mechappa atzmah, kede sheyyirash benah benichse vaalah.
Hecha dekim lan dimubberet hi, tinnase! allema tanya: lo yissa adam meubberet chavero umeneket chavero. veim nasa — yotzi velo yachzir olamit!
Gezera shemma taase ubbarah sandal. i hachi, dideh name!
I leman deamar bemoch — bemoch, vei leman deamar min hashshamayim yerachamu — min hashshamayim yerachamu.
Hacha name: i leman deamar bemoch — bemoch, i leman deamar min hashshamayim yerachamu — min hashshamayim yerachamu!
Ella, mishshum dachsa. i hachi, dideh name! dideh — chayes illaveh. hacha name: chayes illaveh!
Ella: setam meubberet lemenika kayyma,
b: Dilma iabbara umiachar chalva, vekatla leh. i hachi, dideh name! dideh — memasmesa leh bevetzim. vechalav dida name, memasmesa leh bevetzim vechalav! la yahev la baal. (velitbeineh) [vetitbeinhu] leyorshim! amar abbaye: ishsha bosha lavo levet din, vehoreget et benah.
Achat betulot veachat beulot. he nihu betulot vehe nihu arusot? he nihu beulot vehe nihu nesuot?
Amar rabbi yehuda, hachi kaamar: achat betulot veachat beulot shennitarmelu o shennitgarshu, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin.
Rabbi elazar la al leve midresha. ashkecheh lerabbi assi, amar leh: may amur rabbanan beve midresha? amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yose.

Mikkelal dichidaa pelig aleh? in, vehatanya: hare shehayta redufa lelech levet aviha, o shehaya lah kaas bevet balah, o shehaya balah chavush bevet haasurin, o shehaya balah zaken o chole, o shehayta hi chola,

O shehippila achar mitat balah, o shehayta akara, o zekena, o ketanna, o aylonit, o sheenah reuya leled — tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda mattir leares velinnase miyyad.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: chazar bo rabbi yochanan. amar rav yosef: i hadar beh — mimmatnitin decharma hadar beh. detanya: amar rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka, shamati mippi chachamim bakkerem beyavne: kullan tzerichot lehametin shelosha chodashim.

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zerika: ki ayylat lekammeh derabbi avahu, remi leh: mi amar rabbi yochanan halacha kerabbi yose? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna. utenan: kol hannashim lo yinnasu velo yitarsu ad sheyyehu lahem shelosha chodashim, achat betulot veachat beulot!

Amar leh: dirma lach ha — la chash lekimcheh. setam veachar kach machloket hi, veen halacha kistam. deamar rav pappa, veittema rabbi yochanan: machloket veachar kach setam — halacha kistam. setam veachar kach machloket — en halacha kistam.

Mistemich veazel rabbi avahu akkatpeh derabbi nachum shammaeh, menakket veazel hilchata minneh. bea minneh: machloket veachar kach setam may? amar leh: halacha kistam. setam veachar kach machloket may? amar leh: en halacha kistam.
Setama dematnitin umachloket bevarayyta, may? amar leh: halacha kistam. machloket bematnitin usetama bevarayyta, may? amar leh:

a: Vechi rabbi lo shenaah, rabbi chiyyay minnayin lo?
Amar leh, veha tenan: masrek shel pishtan shennittelu shinnav, venishtayyeyru bo shetayim — temeot, veachat — tehora. vechullan shennittelu achat achat bifne atzman — temeot.

Shel tzemer shennittelu shinnav achat mibbentayim — tahor. nishtayyeyru bo shelosh bemakom echad — tame. hayta hachitzona achat mehen — tahor. nittelu shenayim vaasaan lemalket — temeot. achat vehitkinah lener o lemittuach — temea.
Vekayyma lan deen halacha keotah mishna! amar leh: bar minna dehahi, derabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: zo enah mishna.

May tama? amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav idi bereh derav ika: mishshum dekashya resha lesefa. dekatane: shel tzemer shennittelu shinnav achat mibbentayim — tahor. ha nishtayyeyru bo shetayim bemakom echad — tame, vahadar tane nishtayyeyru bo shelosh — tame. shalosh — in, shetayim — la!
Umay kusheya? dilma ha begauoyayta, ha bevarayyta.
Ella mehacha, dekatane: vechullan shennittelu achat achat bifne atzman — temeot, veaf al gav delo hitkinah. ema sefa: achat vehitkinah lener o lemittuach — temea. hitkinah — in, lo hitkinah — la!
Amar abbaye: umay kusheya? dilma ha bekattayyhu, ha bela kattayyhu.
Amar rav pappa: umay kusheya? vedilma ha bekattinata, ha beallimata.
Ella mishshum dimsayyeymi bah davvkane: zo rabbi shimon.
Shalach rabbi chiyyay bar avin: mearsin toch shelosha, vechen osim maase.
Vechen haya rabbi elazar melammedenu mishshum rabbi chanina haggadol: rubbo shel rishon, verubbo shel shelishi, veemtzai shalem.

Ammemar shera leares beyom tishim. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: veha rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: tzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim, chutz miyyom shemmet bo vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo! hahu — leinyan meneket ittemar, derav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: tzericha lehametin esrim vearbaa chodesh, chutz miyyom shennolad bo, vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo.
Veha hahu daavad seudat erusin beyom tishim, veafsedeh rava lisodteh! hahi, seudat nissuin havay.

Vehilcheta: tzericha lehametin esrim vearbaa chodesh — chutz miyyom shennolad bo, vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo. utzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim — chutz miyyom shemmet bo, vechutz miyyom shennitarsa bo.
Chutz min haalmana vechulei. amar rav chisda kal vachomer: uma bimkom sheasur lechabbes, muttar leares. mekom shemmuttar lechabbes — eno din shemmuttar leares?!

May hi, ditnan: shabbat shechal tisha beav betochah — asur lesapper ulechabbes, uvachamishi — muttar, mippene kevod hashshabbat. vetanya: kodem hazzeman hazze — haam memaatin beiskehem, millissa umillitten, millivnot velintoa. umearsin aval lo konsin, veen osin seudat erusin.
Ki tanya hahi, kodem dekodem (tanya).
Amar rava: vekodem dekodem name kal vachomer: uma bimkom sheasur lissa velitten — muttar leares, mekom shemmuttar lissa velitten — eno din shemmuttar leares?!
La tema: derabbi yose omer kol hannashim yitarsu, ella ema: kol hannashim yinnasu.
b: Velet leh lerabbi yose lehavechin?
Let leh. veibbaet ema: leolam it leh, veema, rabbi yose omer: kol arusot gerushot yinnasu.
I hachi, hayeynu rabbi yehuda? ikka benayyhu nesua leares. rabbi yehuda savar: nesua mutteret leares. verabbi yose savar: nesua asura leares.

Vesavar rabbi yose nesua asura leares? vehatanya, rabbi yose omer: kol hannashim yitarsu, chutz min haalmana mippene haibbul, vechamma ibbul shellah — sheloshim yom. vechullan lo yinnasu ad sheyyehu lahen shelosha chodashim.
Hay, may kusheya? illema dekatane, rabbi yose omer: kol hannashim yitarsu — mi allima mimmatnitin, deokemna baarusot gerushot yinnasu, hacha name: kol arusot gerushot yinnasu.
Ella missefa, dekatane: vechullan lo yinnasu ad sheyyehu lahen shelosha chodashim. innesove hu dela, ha itterose — shappir dame!

Amar rava: taretz veema hachi, rabbi yose omer: kol arusot gerushot yinnasu, chutz min haalmana, mippene haibbul. vechamma ibbul shellah — sheloshim yom. unesuot lo yitarsu ad sheyyehe lahen shelosha chodashim.
Vealmana min haerusin mi it la ibbul? vehatane, rabbi chiyyay bar amme: ishto arusa — lo onen velo mittamme lah. vechen hi — lo onenet velo mittammea lo. meta — eno yorshah. met hu — gova ketubbatah!

Ella, tannae hi. detanya: merosh chodesh vead hattaanit haam memaatin meiskehen, millissa umillitten, millivnot velintoa, umilleares umillissa. shabbat shechal tisha beav betochah — asur lesapper ulechabbes (veasur leares). veyesh omrim: kol hachodesh asur.
Matkef la rav ashe: mimmay deleares, leares mammash? dilma lemibad seudat erusin hu deasur, ha leares — shappir dame.
I hachi, millissa (linnase) name, lemebad seudat nissuin hu deasur, ha lissa shappir dame? hachi hasheta?! bishlama nissuin belo seuda — ikka simcha, ella erusin belo seuda — mi ikka simcha?
Ella amar rav ashe: shane avelut chadasha meavelut yeshana, veshane avelut derabbim meavelut deyachid.
Mishna arbaa achin nesuin arba nashim vametu, im ratza haggadol shebbahem leyaybem et kullan — harshut beyado.
Mi shehaya nasuy lishte nashim umet — biatah o chalitzatah shel achat mehen poteret tzaratah.

a: Hayta achat keshera veachat pesula, im haya choletz — choletz lappesula, veim haya meyaybem — meyaybem lakkeshera.
Gemara arbaa achin salka datach? ella ema: arbaa meachin.
Harshut beyado. veshavki leh? vehatanya: "vekaru lo zikne iro" — hen velo sheluchan. "vedibberu elav" — melammed shemmassiin lo etza hogenet lo.
Sheim haya hu yeled vehi zekena, hu zaken vehi yalda, omrin lo: ma lecha etzel yalda, ma lecha etzel zekena? kelach etzel shekkemotcha, veal tasim ketata bevetecha.
La tzericha, deefshar leh. i hachi, afillu tuva name! etza tova ka mashma lan: arba — in, tefe — la, ki hechi denimteyeh ona bechodesh.
Mi shehaya nasuy vechulei. uneyaybem letarvayyhu! amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: amar kera: "asher lo yivne et bet achiv", bayit echad hu bone, veen bone shene vattim.
Venachlotz letarvayyhu?! amar mar zutera bar toviyya, amar kera: "bet chalutz hannaal", bayit echad hu choletz, veen choletz shene vattim.
Uneyaybem lachada venachlotz lachada! amar kera: "im lo yachpotz", ha chafetz — yeyabbem. kol haole leyibbum — ole lachalitza, kol sheen ole leyibbum — en ole lachalitza.
Veod, shello yomru: bayit miktzato banuy umiktzato chalutz. veyomru! i dimyaybem vahadar chaletz — hachi name. ella, [dilma] chaletz vahadar meyaybem, vekam leh belo yivne".
Veema: ki ikka chada — titkayyem mitzvat yibbum, ki ikka tarte — lo titkayyem mitzvat yibbum!
Im ken, tzarat erva deasar rachamana lema li? hasheta tarte bealma amrat lav bene chalitza veyibbum ninhu — tzarat erva mibbaya?
Allema la? itzterich, salka datach amena: erva abbaray kayyma, vetityaybem tzarata, ka mashma lan daasira.
Ella: "yevimto" "yevimto" — ribba.
Hayta achat keshera. amar rav yosef, kan shana rabbi: lo yishpoch adam me voro, vaacherim tzerichim lahem.
Mishna hammachzir gerushato, vehannose chalutzato, vehannose kerovat chalutzato — yotzi, vehavvalad mamzer, divre rabbi akiva.
Vachachamim omrim: en havvalad mamzer. umodim benose kerovat gerushato — shehavvalad mamzer.
Gemara vesavar rabbi akiva hannose kerovat chalutzato havvalad mamzer? vehaamar resh lakish, kan shana rabbi: achot gerusha middivre tora, achot chalutza middivre sofrim! teni: kerovat gerushato.
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: umodim benose kerovat gerushato shehavvalad mamzer. i amrat bishlama ayyri bah — hayeynu dekatane "umodim". ella i amrat la ayyri ba, may "umodim"?

Vedilma ha ka mashma lan, deyesh mamzer mechayyayve karetot. ha katane la lekamman: ezehu mamzer — kol sheer basar shehu belo yavo" — divre rabbi akiva, rabbi shimon hattimni omer: kol shechayyayvin alav karet bide shamayim. vahalacha kidvarav.
Vedilma kasatem lan tanna kerabbi shimon hattimni. im ken, litne shear chayyayve karetot, kerovat gerushato lema li? ella shema minna ayyri ba.
[Vedilma] leolam la ayyri ba, veayyeyde ditna machazir gerushato venose chalutzato ukerovat chalutzato — tane name kerovat gerushato.
Ella: kerovat chalutzato lerabbi akiva have mamzer. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hayeynu tama derabbi akiva, deamar kera: "bet chalutz hannaal", hakkatuv kerao "beto".
Amar rav yosef amar rabbi shimon bar rabbi: hakkol modim bemachazir gerushato,
