b: Shehavvalad pagum lakkehunna. man hakkol modim — shimon hattimni, deaf al gav deamar shimon hattimni: en mamzer mechayyayve lavin, nehi demamzer la have, pagum miha have,
Mikkal vachomer mealmana. uma almana lechohen gadol, sheen issurah shave bakkol — benah pagum, zo, sheissurah shave bakkol — eno din shebbenah pagum?
Ikka lemifrach: ma lealmana shekken hi atzmah mitchallelet.
Veod: "hi toeva" ketiv, veen baneha toavin.

Veod, tanya: hammachazir gerushato vehannose chalutzato vehannose kerovat chalutzato, rabbi akiva omer: en lo bah kiddushin, veenah tzericha hemennu get, vehi pesula, uveladah pasul, vechofin oto lehotzi. vachachamim omrim: yesh lo bah kiddushin, utzericha hemennu get, vehi keshera uveladah kasher.
Leman, lav lichhunna? la, lakkahal. i hachi, hi keshera, leman? ilema lakkahal — peshita, mishshum dezanneya ippasla lakkahal?! ella lav lichhunna,
Umiddehi lichhunna, veladah name lichhunna! midde irya? ha kidita veha kidita.
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane resha: hi pesula uveladah pasul. hi pesula leman? ilema lakkahal, mishshum dezanneya ippasla leh lakkahal?! ella lav lichhunna.
Uveladah pasul, leman? ilema lichhunna: ha lakkahal kasher? haamar rabbi akiva: havvalad mamzer! ella peshita lakkahal.
Umidderesha ha kidita veha kidita, sefa name ha kidita veha kidita.
Vehi toeva" name — hi toeva veen tzaratah toeva, aval baneha toavin.
Ella almana kashya: ma lealmana shekken hi atzmah mitchallelet!

Ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rav yosef amar rabbi shimon berabbi: hakkol modim beva al chayyayve karetot shehavvalad pagum. man hakkol modim, rabbi yehoshua. deaf al gav deamar rabbi yehoshua: en mamzer mechayyayve karetot, nehi demamzer la have — pagum miha have,
Mikkal vachomer mealmana: uma almana lechohen gadol, sheen issurah shave — bakkol benah pagum, zo sheissurah shave bakkol — eno din shebbenah pagum.
Vechi tema: ma lealmana, shekken hi atzmah mitchallelet — hacha name, kevan shebbealah, asaah zona.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim beeved vegoy habba al bat yisrael shehavvalad mamzer.
Man "hakkol modim" — shimon hattimni. deaf al gav deamar shimon hattimni en mamzer mechayyayve lavin — hane mille

a: Mechayyayve lavin detafsi behu kiddushin, aval hacha, goy veeved, kevan dela tafsi behu kiddushin — kechayyayve karetot deme.
Metivi: goy veeved habba al bat yisrael — havvalad mamzer. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer: en mamzer ella mimmi sheissuro issur erva veanush karet.

Ella amar rav yosef: man "hakkol modim" — rabbi, af al gav derabbi omer: en haddevarim hallalu amurim ella ledivre rabbi akiva, shehaya ose chalutza keerva, veleh la sevira leh, begoy veeved mode. dechi ata rav dimi, amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi mishshum rabbenu: goy veeved habba al bat yisrael — havvalad mamzer.

Rabbi acha sar habbira verabbi tanchum bereh derabbi chiyyay ish kefar akko peruk hanhu shevuyayta daato mearmon litverya. hava chada deiabbara miggoy, vaato lekammeh derabbi amme, amar lehu: rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar verabbi chanina deamri: goy veeved habba al bat yisrael — havvalad mamzer.

Amar rav yosef: revuta lemichshav gavre?! ha rav ushemuel bevavel, verabbi yehoshua ben levi uvar kappara beeretz yisrael, veamri la challofe bar kappara veayyoyle zikne darom, deamri: goy veeved habba al bat yisrael havvalad kasher!
Ella amar rav yosef: rabbi hi. dechi ata rav dimi amar rabbi yitzchak bar avudimi: mishshum rabbenu amru: goy veeved habba al bat yisrael — havvalad mamzer.
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi omer: havvalad mekulekal. leman? ilema lakkahal — ha amar rabbi yehoshua: havvalad kasher! ella lichhunna, dechullehu amorae demachsheri — modu shehavvalad pagum lichhunna.
Mikkal vechomer mealmana: ma almana lechohen gadol, sheen issurah shave bakkol — benah pagum, zo sheissurah shave bakkol — eno din shebbenah pagum.
Ma lealmana lechohen gadol shekken hi atzmah mitchallelet! hacha name, kevan shennivala — pesalah.

Deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon: minnayin legoy veeved habba al hakkohenet veal halleviyya veal hayyisreelit sheppesaluha — shenneemar: "uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugerusha", mi sheyyesh lo almenut vegerushin bah, yatzu goy veeved sheen lahem almenut vegerushin bah.
Amar leh abbaye: may chazet desamchat adderav dimi — semoch adderavin! dechi ata ravin, amar: rabbi natan verabbi yehuda hannasi moru ba lehettera. uman rabbi yehuda hannasi — rabbi.
Veaf rav more ba [l]hettera. dehahu daata lekammeh derav, amar leh: goy veeved habba al bat yisrael, mahu?
Amar leh: havvalad kasher. amar leh: hav li berattach. la yahevna lach.
Amar shimi bar chiyyay lerav, amri inashe: gamla bemaday akkabba rakda. ha kabba, veha gamla, veha maday — vela rakda!
Amar leh: i nihve kihoshua bin nun — la yahevna leh beratti. amar leh: i hava kihoshua bin nun, i mar la yahev leh — acharine yahavi leh, hay i mar la yahev leh — acharine la yahavi leh.
La hava kaazel mikkammeh. yehev beh eneh ushechev.

Veaf rav matna more ba lehettera, veaf rav yehuda more ba lehettera. dechi ata lekammeh derav yehuda, amar leh: zil ittammar, o nesev bat minnach. vechi ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: o geli, o nesev bat minnach.
Shelachu leh bene be michse lerabba: mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin habba al bat yisrael, mahu? amar lehu: hasheta eved kullo, amrinan kasher — chetzyo mibbaya?
Amar rav yosef: mara dishmata
b: Mannu — rav yehuda. veha amar rav yehuda: mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin habba al bat yisrael — oto valad en lo takkana!
Ki ittemar derav yehuda, kegon dekaddesh bat yisrael, denimtza tzad avdut shebbo mishtammesh beeshet ish.
Vehaamri nehardae mishshemeh derabbi yaakov: ledivre happosel — posel afillu bifnuya, ledivre hammachshir — machshir afillu beeshet ish.
Ushenehem lo lemaduha ella meeshet av. man defasel savar: ma eshet av dela tafsi ba kiddushin [havvalad mamzer], af kol dela tafsi ba kiddushin — havvalad mamzer.
Uman demachshar savar: ma eshet av, dildideh la tafsi ba kiddushin, leacharine tafsi ba kiddushin, leappoke goy veeved dela tafsi behu kiddushin kelal.
Ella: ki ittemar derav yehuda, kegon shebba al eshet ish, venimtza tzad cherut shebbo mishtammesh beeshet ish.

Amar ravina, amar li rav gazza: ikkela rabbi yose bar avin leatrin vahava ovada bifnuya, veachshar. beeshet ish, ufesayl. amar rav sheshet: ledidi amar li rav gazza: la rabbi yose bar avin hava ella rabbi yose berabbi zevida hava, veachshar ben bifnuya ben beeshet ish. amar leh rav acha bereh derabba leravina: ikkela ammemar leatrin veachshar ben bifnuya ben beeshet ish.
Vehilcheta: goy veeved habba al bat yisrael — havvalad kasher, ben bifnuya ben beeshet ish.

Rava achshereh lerav mari bar rachel umanneyeh befurese devavel, veaf al gav deamar mar: "som tasim alecha melech" — kol mesimot sheatta mesim al yehu ella mikkerev achecha, hay, kevan deimmo miyyisrael — "mikkerev achecha" karenan beh.
Avdeh derabbi chiyyay bar amme atbela lehahi goya leshem inteta. amar rav yosef: yachelna leachshore ba uvivratta.
Ba, kidrav assi. deamar rav assi, mi la tevala lenidduta?
Bivratta, goy veeved habba al bat yisrael — havvalad kasher.
Hahu dahavo karu leh "bar armayyta", amar rav assi: mi la tevala lenidduta? hahu dahavo karu leh "bar armaa". amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: mi la teval lekiryo?
Amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: hallokeach eved min haggoy, vekadam vetaval leshem ben chorin, kana atzmo ben chorin. may tama —

a: Goy gufa la kane leh, may dekane leh hu demakne leh leyisrael, vechevan dikdam uteval leshem ben chorin — afkeeh leshibudeh.
Kidrava, deamar rava: hekdesh, chametz veshichrur — mafkiin mide shibud.
Metiv rav chisda: maase bivlorya haggiyyoret shekkadmu avadeha vetavlu lefaneha, uva maase lifne chachamim, veamru: kanu atzman bene chorin. lefaneha — in, leachareha — la!
Amar rava: lefaneha, ben bistam ben bimforesh. leachareha, bimforesh — in, bistam — la.
Amar rav avya: lo shanu ella belokeach min haggoy, aval goy gufeh — kane.
Dichtiv: "vegam mibbene hattoshavim haggarim immachem mehem tiknu", attem konim mehem, velo hem konim mikkem, velo hem konim ze mizze.

Velo hem konim mikkem. lemay? ilema lemaase yadav — attu goy la kane leh leyisrael lemaase yadav? vehachtiv: "o leeker mishpachat ger", veamar mar: "mishpachat ger" — ze haggoy! ella lav, legufeh. vekaamar rachamana: attem konin mehem — afillu gufeh.
Parech rav acha: ema bechaspa uvitvila! kashya.
Amar shemuel, vetzarich letokpo bammayim.

Ki hay deminyamin avdeh derav ashe bea (laatabevaley) [leatboleh]. masreh nihalayyhu leravina ulerav acha bereh derava. amar lehu: chazo deminnayychu kavaena leh, remo leh arvisa betzavvereh, arpo leh vetzamtzimu leh.

Arpo leh — ki hechi dela leheve chatzitza. tzamtzimu leh — ki hechi dela lakdem velema lehu: leshem ben chorin ani tovel. bahade dedalli resheh mimmayya, annechu leh zuleta detina aresheh vaamaru leh: zil amti leve marach.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: chazi mar hane deve pappa bar abba, deyahavi zuzi leinashe lichragayyhu umeshabedi behu. ki nafki, tzerichi gitta decheruta, o la?
Amar leh: ikko shechevi la amari lechu ha milleta. hachi amar rav sheshet: muherkayyhu dehane, betufsa demalka mannach, umalka amar: man dela yahev keraga, mishtabed leman deyahev keraga.

Rabbi chiyyay bar abba ikkela legavla. chaza benot yisrael dimabberan miggerim shemmalu velo tavlu, vachaza chamra deyisrael demazgi goyim veshatu yisrael, vachaza tormosin deshalki goyim veachli yisrael, vela amar lehu vela midde.
Ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan. amar leh: tze vehacherez al benehem shehem mamzerim, veal yenam mishshum yen nesech, veal tormosan mishshum bishshule goyim, lefi sheenan bene tora.

Al benehen shehem mamzerim — rabbi yochanan letameh. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: leolam en ger ad sheyyamul veyitbol. vechevan dela tavel, goy hu. veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: goy veeved habba al bat yisrael — havvalad mamzer.
Veal yenam mishshum yen nesech — mishshum: "lach lach, amrin nezira, sechor sechor, lecharma la tikrav".

Veal tormosan mishshum bishshule goyim — lefi sheenan bene tora. ha bene tora shere? vehaamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak mishshemeh derav: kol hanneechol kemot shehu chay — en bo mishshum bishshule goyim. veha tormos eno neechol kemot shehu chay, veyesh bo mishshum bishshule goyim!

Rabbi yochanan keiddach lishshana sevira leh, deamar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak mishshemeh derav: kol sheen ole al shulechan melachim leechol bo et happat — en bo mishshum bishshule goyim, vetama deenan bene tora, ha bene tora shere.

Tanu rabbanan: ger shemmal velo taval, rabbi eliezer omer: hare ze ger, shekken matzinu baavotenu shemmalu velo tavlu. taval velo mal, rabbi yehoshua omer: hare ze ger, shekken matzinu baimmahot shettavlu velo malu. vachachamim omrim: taval velo mal, mal velo taval — en ger ad sheyyamul veyitbol.
Verabbi yehoshua name nelaf meavot, verabbi eliezer name nelaf meimmahot! vechi tema, en danin efshar mishshei efshar.

Vehatanya, rabbi eliezer omer: minnayin lefesach dorot sheen ba ella min hachullin — neemar pesach bemitzrayim, veneemar pesach bedorot. ma pesach haamur bemitzrayim — en ba ella min hachullin, af pesach haamur ledorot — en ba ella min hachullin.
Amar lo rabbi akiva: vechi danin efshar mishshei efshar? amar lo: af al pi shei efshar — reaya gedola hi, venilmad hemenna.
Ella
b: Betaval velo mal — kulle alma la peligi demahne, ki peligi bemal velo taval. rabbi eliezer yalef meavot, verabbi yehoshua: beavot name tevila hava.
Mena leh? illema middichtiv: "lech el haam vekiddashtam hayyom umachar vechibbesu simlotam", uma bimkom sheen taun kibbus — taun tevila, mekom shettaun kibbus — eno din shettaun tevila.
Vedilma, nekiyyut bealma?!
Ella mehacha: "vayyikkach moshe et haddam vayyizrok al haam", ugemiri deen hazzaa belo tevila.
Verabbi yehoshua, tevila baimmahot menalan? sevara hu, deim ken, bamme nichnesu tachat kanfe hashshechina?
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: leolam eno ger ad sheyimmol veyitbol. peshita, yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim!
Man chachamim — rabbi yose.
Detanya: hare shebba veamar malti velo tavalti — matbilin oto, uma bechach, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: en matbilin.
Lefichach matbilin ger beshabbat, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi yose omer: en matbilin.
Amar mar: lefichach matbilin ger beshabbat. peshita, kevan deamar rabbi yehuda bachada saggi, hecha demal lefanenu — matbilin, may "lefichach"?
Mahu detema: lerabbi yehuda tevila ikkar, utevila beshabbat la, deka metakken gavra. ka mashma lan derabbi yehuda o ha o ha bae.
Rabbi yose omer: en matbilin. peshita, dechevan deamar rabbi yose tarte baenan — takkone gavra beshabbat la metakkeninan!
Mahu detema: lerabbi yose mila ikkar, vehatam hu dela havay mila befanenu, aval hecha dahavay mila befanenu — ema (litbol ze) [laytbeleh] beshabbeta. ka mashma lan derabbi yose tarte bae.

Amar rabba: ovada hava be rabbi chiyyay bar rabbi, verav yosef matni rabbi oshaya bar rabbi, verav safra matne rabbi oshaya berabbi chiyyay, daata lekammeh ger shemmal velo taval. amar leh: shehi kan ad limchar venatbelinach.
Shema minna telat. shema minna: ger tzarich shelosha. ushema minna: eno ger ad sheyimmol veyitbol. ushema minna: en matbilin ger ballayla. venema: shema minna name baenan mumechin? dilma deikkelau.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: ger tzarich shelosha, "mishpat" ketiv beh.
Tanu rabbanan: mi shebba veamar "ger ani", yachol nekabbelennu — talmud lomar: "ittecha", bemuchezak lecha. ba veedav immo, minnayin — talmud lomar: "vechi yagur ittecha ger beartzechem".

a: En li ella baaretz, bechutz laaretz minnayin? talmud lomar: "ittecha" — bechol makom sheittecha. im ken, ma talmud lomar "baaretz"? baaretz — tzarich lehavi reaya, bechutz laaretz — en tzarich lehavi reaya, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz — tzarich lehavi reaya.
Ba hu veedav immo, kera lema li? amar rav sheshet: deamri: shamanu shennitgayyer bevet din shel peloni. salka datach amena la leyhemniyhu, ka mashma lan.
"Baaretz" — en li ella baaretz. bechutza laaretz minnayin — talmud lomar: "ittecha", bechol makom sheittecha. veha appekteh? chada meittecha" vachada meimmach".
Vachachamim omrim: ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz tzarich lehavi reaya. veella ha ketiv "baaretz"!

Hahu mibbee leh, daafillu baaretz mekabbelim gerim. desalka datach amena: mishshum tevuta deeretz yisrael kamiggayyeyri, vehasheta name delekka tevuta, ikka leket shichcha ufea umasar ani, ka mashma lan.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: halacha, ben baaretz ben bechutz laaretz tzarich lehavi reaya. peshita, yachid verabbim halacha kerabbim! mahu detema: mistabbar tama derabbi yehuda, dekamsayyeyi leh kerae, ka mashma lan.
Tanu rabbanan: "ushefattem tzedek ben ish uven achiv uven gero", mikkan amar rabbi yehuda: ger shennitgayyer bevet din — hare ze ger, beno leven atzmo — eno ger.

Maase beechad shebba lifne rabbi yehuda, veamar lo: nitgayyayrti beni leven atzmi. amar lo rabbi yehuda: yesh lecha edim? amar lo: lav. yesh lecha banim? amar lo: hen. amar lo: neeman atta lifsol et atzmecha, vei atta neeman lifsol et banecha.

[Umi] amar rabbi yehuda abbanim la meheman? vehatanya: "yakkir" — yakkirennu laacherim. mikkan amar rabbi yehuda: neeman adam lomar "ze beni bechor", ucheshem shenneeman lomar "ze beni bechor", kach neeman lomar: "beni ze ben gerusha hu", o "ben chalutza hu". vachachamim omrim: eno neeman!

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, hachi kaamar leh: lidvarecha goy atta, veen edut legoy. ravina amar, hachi kaamar leh: yesh lecha banim? hen. yesh lecha bene vanim? hen. amar lo: neeman atta lifsol banecha, vei atta neeman lifsol bene vanecha.

Tanya name hachi, rabbi yehuda omer: neeman adam lomar al beno katan, veen neeman al beno gadol. veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lo katan katan mammash, velo gadol gadol mammash. ella, katan veyesh lo banim — zehu gadol. gadol veen lo banim — zehu katan.
Vehilcheta kevoteh derav nachman bar yitzchak. vehatanya kevoteh deravina! hahu, leinyan "yakkir" ittemar.

Tanu rabbanan: ger shebba lehitgayyer bizman hazze, omrim lo: ma raita shebbata lehitgayyer? i atta yodea sheyyisrael bizman hazze devuyim, dechufim, sechufim umetorafin, veyissurin bain alehem? im omer: yodea ani, veeni keday — mekabbelin oto miyyad.

Umodiin oto miktzat mitzvot kallot umiktzat mitzvot chamurot, umodiin oto avon leket shichcha ufea umasar ani. umodiin oto onshan shel mitzvot. omrim lo: heve yodea shead shello bata lemidda zo, achalta chelev — i atta anush karet. chillalta shabbat — i atta anush sekila. veachshav, achalta chelev — anush karet, chillalta shabbat — anush sekila.
Ucheshem shemmodiin oto onshan shel mitzvot, kach modiin oto mattan secharan. omrim lo: heve yodea shehaolam habba eno asuy ella letzaddikim, veyisrael bizman hazze enam yecholim lekabbel
b: Lo rov tova velo rov pureanut. veen marbin alav, veen medakdekin alav.

Kibbel — malin oto miyyad. nishtayyeyru bo tzitzin hameakkevin et hammila — chozrim umalin oto sheniyya. nitrappe — matbilin oto miyyad. ushene talmide chachamim omdim al gabbav umodiin oto miktzat mitzvot kallot umiktzat mitzvot chamurot. taval veala — hare hu keyisrael lechol devarav.
Ishsha — nashim moshivot otah bemayim ad tzavvarah, ushene talmide chachamim omdim lah mibbachutz, umodiin otah miktzat mitzvot kallot umiktzat mitzvot chamurot.
Echad ger, veechad eved meshucherar. uvimkom shennidda tovelet, sham ger veeved meshucherar tovlin. vechol davar shechotzetz bitvila, chotzetz beger uveeved meshucherar uvenidda.

Amar mar: ger shebba lehitgayyer, omrim lo: ma raita shebbata lehitgayyer? umodiim oto miktzat mitzvot kallot umiktzat mitzvot chamurot. may tama? dei paresh — nifrosh. deamar rabbi chelbo: kashim gerim leyisrael kesappachat, dichtiv: "venilva hagger alehem venispechu al bet yaakov".
Umodiim oto avon leket shichcha ufea umasar ani. may tama? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: ben noach neherag al pachot mishshave peruta — velo nittan lehishshavon.
(Umodiim oto avon shichcha ufea) veen marbim alav veen medakdekim alav. amar rabbi elazar: may keraa — dichtiv: "vattere ki mitammetzet hi lalechet ittah vattechdal ledabber eleha".
Amara la: asir lan techum shabbat — "baasher telchi elech". asir lan yichud — "baasher talini alin".

Mippakdinan shesh meot ushelosh esre mitzvot — "ammech ammi". asir lan avoda zara — "velohayich elohay". arba mitot nimseru levet din — "baasher tamuti amut". shene kevarim nimseru levet din — "vesham ekkaver".
Miyyad, "vattere ki mitammetzet hi vegomer".
Kibbel — malin oto miyyad. may tama — shahoye mitzva la meshahenan.

Nishtayyeyru bo tzitzin hameakkevin hammila vechulei. keditnan: ellu hen tzitzin hameakkevin hammila — basar hachofe et rov haatara. veeno ochel bitruma. veamar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: basar hachofe rov govhah shel atara.
Nitrappe — matbilin oto miyyad. nitrappe — in, lo nitrappe — la. may tama? mishshum demayya marzu makka.
Ushene talmide chachamim omdim al gabbav. veha amar rabbi chiyyay amar rabbi yochanan: ger tzarich shelosha! ha amar rabbi yochanan letanna: teni, shelosha.
Taval veala hare hu keyisrael lechol devarav. lemay hilcheta? dei hadar beh umekaddesh bat yisrael, yisrael meshummad karena beh, vekiddushav kiddushin.
Echad ger veechad eved meshucherar. kasalka datach, lekabbel alav ol mitzvot. ureminhu: bamme devarim amurim — beger, aval beeved meshucherar — en tzarich lekabbel!
Amar rav sheshet, la kashya: ha — rabbi shimon ben elazar, ha — rabbanan.
Detanya: "uvachta et aviha veet immah vegomer". bamme devarim amurim — shello kibbela aleha. aval kibbela aleha — matbilah, umuttar bah miyyad.
